sa: ततस्त्वैलविलाल्लेभे धुन्धुमारो नरेश्वरः॥ धुन्धुमाराच्च काम्बोजो मुचुकुन्दस्ततोऽलभत्।
en: Ailavila gave it to king Dhundumara. Dhundumara gave it to Kamvoja, and Kamvoja to Muchukunda.

sa: विदुर उवाच बाहुश्रुत्यं तपस्त्यागः श्रद्धा यज्ञक्रिया क्षमा। भावशुद्धिर्दया सत्यं संयमश्चात्मसम्पदः॥
en: Vidura said Study of the various scriptures, asceticism, gift, faith, celebration of sacrifices, forgiveness, sincerity of purpose, mercy, truth, self-control,-these form the possessions of Virtue.

sa: सर्वत्यागे च यतते दृष्ट्वा लोकं क्षयात्मकम्। ततो मोक्षाय यतते नानुपायादुपायतः॥
en: Seeing then all the worlds as being subject top destruction, he tries to renounce virtue and tries to attain to Liberation by the (well-known) means.

sa: स नेह सुखमाप्नोति कुत एव परत्र वै॥ एवं भवति पापात्मा धर्मात्मानं तु मे शृणु।
en: He cannot acquire happiness even here. Whence then would he succeed in acquiring happiness hereafter? It is thus that one becomes sinful. Listen now to me as I describe to you one who is righteous.

sa: भगीरथरथाक्रान्तदेशान् गङ्गानिषेवितान्। ये चरन्ति महामीनास्तांश्च तस्यान्वकल्पयत्॥
en: He also gave him several large fishes caught from the deep waters of the Bhagirathi.

sa: तं काश्यपोऽबवीत् प्रीतो नोत्कण्ठां कर्तुमर्हसि। कृतकार्यो द्विजश्रेष्ठ सद्रव्यो यास्यसे गृहान्॥
en: The son of Kashyapa cheerfully told him,You should not feel any anxiety. You shall succeed, O foremost of Brahmanas, and shall return home with property.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच इमे सब्रह्मका लोकाः ससुरासुरमानवाः। क्रियास्वभ्युदयोक्तासु सक्ता दृश्यन्ति सर्वशः॥
en: The whole world of Being, with Brahman, the gods, the Asuras, and human beings are seen to be deeply attached to acts which yield prosperity.

sa: ततः स ब्राह्मणः स्वप्ने कुण्डधारस्य तेजसा। अपश्यत् सर्वभूतानि कुशेषु शयितस्तदा॥
en: After this, that Brahmana, stretched on a bed of Kusha grass, and penetrated with the energy of Kundadhara, saw all living beings in a dream.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि इतिहासं पुरातनम्। कुण्डधारेण यत् प्रीत्या भक्तायोपकृतं पुरा॥
en: Bhishma said About it I shall recite to you the ancient discourse of the benefit which Kundadhara in days of yore had conferred upon one who was devoted to him.

sa: विदुः कृष्ण परां भक्तिमस्मासु तव शत्रुहान्। क्रियतामात्मनः श्रेयः प्रीतिर्हि त्वयि मे परा॥
en: We know, O Krishna, that you, O slayer of foes, are greatly devoted to us! Do what is for your good. My love and affection for you is very great.

sa: रुद्रो रोषात्मको जातो दशान्यान् सोऽसृजत् स्वयम्। एकादशैते रुद्रास्तु विकारपुरुषाः स्मृताः॥
en: Then originated Rudra from the principle of anger. Taking birth, he created ten others like him. These eleven Rudras are called by name of Vikara-Purushas.

sa: ते रुद्राः प्रकृतिश्चैव सर्वे चैव सुरर्षयः। उत्पन्ना लोकसिद्ध्यर्थं ब्रह्माणं समुपस्थिताः॥
en: The Rudras, the Prakritis, and the several celestial Rishis, having come into existence approached Brahman, with the object of upholding the universe and its work.

sa: निरीक्ष्य भगवान् देवी ह्युमां मां च जगद्धितः। शतक्रतुं चाभिवीक्ष्य स्वयं मामाह शङ्करः॥
en: The powerful Shankara then, given to the behoof of the universe, looked at the goddess Uma, and the king of the celestials and myself also, and thus spoke to me.

sa: सत्यवानुवाच तान् न शक्नोषि चेत् साधून् परित्रातुमहिंसया। कस्यचिद् भूतभव्यस्य लाभेनान्तं तथा कुरु॥
en: Satyavat said If you cannot make honest men of those rogues and in saying them by means other than destruction, do you then root them out by celebrating some sacrifice.

sa: दस्यून् निहन्ति वै राजा भूयसो वाप्यनागसः। भार्या माता पिता पुत्रो हन्यन्ते पुरुषेण ते। परेणापकृतो राजा तस्मात् सम्यक् प्रधारयेत्॥
en: By killing the wicked, the king kills a large number of innocent men. See, by killing a single robber, his wife, mother, father, and children are all killed. When injured by a wicked person, the king should, therefore, think seriously on the question of punishment.

sa: किं कृत्वा धारयेयं वै प्राणानित्यभ्यचिन्तयत्। ततः स पथि भोक्तव्यं प्रक्षमाणो न किंचन॥
en: What should I do for keeping my life?— Thus he thought. It so happened that even upon much thinking he found no food which he could eat on the way.

sa: गौतमस्तं ततो दृष्ट्वा शिरसा पतितं भुवि। पत्नीं चैव निराकारां परामभ्यागमन्मुदम्॥
en: Seeing his son prostrated before him with bent head, and seeing also his wife almost petrified with shame, the Rishi became filled with great joy.

sa: यो ह्ययं मयि संघातो मयत्वे पाञ्चभौतिकः। यस्य मे जननी हेतुः पावकस्य यथारणिः॥
en: Of this the mother is the principal cause of those union of the five elements in me due to my birth as a human being, as the fire-sticks of fire.

sa: सुरा मत्स्या मधु मासंमासवं कृसरौदनम्। धूर्तेः प्रवर्तितं ह्येतन्नैतद् वेदेषु कल्पितम्॥
en: Knavas have introduced wine, fish, honey, meat, alchohol, and preparations of rice and sesame seeds. The use of these is not sanctioned in the Vedas.

sa: भविष्यति द्विजश्रेष्ठ मयि भक्तिश्च शाश्वती। सांनिध्यं चाश्रमे नित्यं करिष्यामि द्विजोत्तम॥
en: O foremost of twiceborn ones, your devotion to me shall be eternal. And, O best of Brahmanas. I shall always be present at your hermitage.

sa: यदि देयो वरो मह्यं यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे प्रभो। भक्तिर्भवतु मे नित्यं त्वयि देव सुरेश्वर॥
en: If, O Lord, you have been pleased with me and if you would grant me boons, let this be the boon, O Lord of all the gods, that my devotion to you may remain unchanged.

sa: आदिस्त्वमसि लोकानां संहर्ता काल एव च। यच्चान्यदपि लोके वै सर्वं तेजोधिकं स्मृतम्।।३२६
en: You are the Sun among all things in the worlds, you are the destroyer called Kala. You are whatever else gifted with superior energy or eminence existing in the universe.

sa: अरण्यानां पशूनां च सिंहस्त्वं परमेश्वरः। ग्राम्याणां गोवृषश्चासि भवाँल्लोकप्रपूजितः॥
en: You are the lion among all the beasts, and the bull adored of all among all domestic animals. are are

sa: इह चैवागतस्तेन विसृष्टः परमात्मना। एवं मे भगवान् देवः स्वयमाख्यातवान् हरिः। आसिष्ये तत्परो भूत्वा युवाभ्यां सह नित्यशः॥
en: Dismissed by him who is the Supreme Soul, I am coming here. This is what the illustrious and holy Hari has himself said to me. I shall henceforth live with you two, devoted to Narayana in the form of Anirudhha.

sa: सुखं जीवन्ति मुनयो भैक्ष्यवृत्तिं समाश्रिताः। अद्रोहेणैव भूतानां सारङ्गा इव पक्षिणः॥
en: Adopting the life of mendicancy, the ascetics live in happiness, without having any object of fear from any creature, like the bees in the forest.

sa: अपरे बाहुबलिनः कृतविद्या मनस्विनः। जुगुप्सितां च कृपणां पापवृत्तिमुपासते॥
en: Although gifted with strength of arms, knowledge and great energy of mind, others again, follow censurable, sinful, and miserable callings.

sa: तेषां मध्यगतो देवो रराज भगवाञ्छिवः॥ शरदभ्रविनिर्मुक्तः परिधिस्थ इवांशुमान्।
en: In their midst was the illustrious god like the sun in the midst of his corona, come from autumnal clouds.

sa: स्वाध्यायमग्निसंस्कारमप्रमत्तोऽनुपा सत्यं दमं च दानं च स्पर्धिष्ठा मा च केनचित्॥
en: Engage, in Vedic studies, and properly maintain your consecrated hearth, and observe can to truth, and self-control, and charity. Never compare yourself boastfully with another.

sa: त्रिःसप्तकृत्वः पृथिवी येन निःक्षत्रिया कृता। जामदग्न्येन गोविन्द रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा॥
en: It was with that weapon that Jamadagni's son, O Govinda, was able to root out the Kshatriyas for twenty-one times.

sa: नारद उवाच श्रुत्वा तु वचनं देवः स्थाणोनियतवाङ्मनाः। तेजस्तत् संनिजग्राह पुनरेवान्तरात्मनि॥
en: Narada continued Hearing these words of Sthanu, the divine Brahma of controlled speech and mind himself suppressed that energy of his within his own heart.

sa: साहमेतानि कर्माणि राजदुःखानि मैथिल। समर्था शतशो वक्तुमथवापि सहस्रशः॥
en: O king of Mithila, I can mention hundreds and thousands of faults like these that belong to kings and kingdoms.

sa: व्यक्ते मनसि संलीने व्यक्त चाव्यक्ततां गते।॥ अव्यक्ते पुरुषं याते पुंसि सर्वगतेऽपि च।
en: Mind merges into the Manifest. The Manifest merges into the Unmanifest (or Nature). The Unmanifest (or Nature) merges into Purusha (Soul) and Purusha merges into the Supreme Soul (or Brahma).

sa: भूमेः स्थैर्यं गुरुत्वं च काठिन्यं प्रसवार्थता। गन्धो गुरुत्वं शक्तिश्च संघातः स्थापना धृतिः॥
en: The properties of earth are immobility, weight, hardness, productiveness, scent, density, capacity to absorb all sorts of scents, cohesion, habitableness, and that attribute of the mind which is called patience.

sa: यस्तान् पाशान् वशे कृत्वा तं वक्षमपकर्षति। गतः स दुःखयोरन्तं जरामरणयोर्द्वयोः।
en: He who, subduing those chains, cuts down that tree and seeks to renounce both sorrow and joy, succeeds in attaining to the end of both.

sa: बीजमात्रं पुरा सृष्टं यदेतत् परिवर्तते। मृतामृताः प्रणश्यन्ति बीजाद् बीजं प्रवर्तते॥
en: Only seeds were originally created. All this universe is the creation of seeds in succession. They that die, die for ever. Seeds come from seeds.

sa: मम वेदा हृताः सर्वे दानवाभ्यां बलादितः। अन्धकारा हि मे लोका जाता वेदैविनाकृताः॥
en: All the Vedas, however, have been by force taken away from me by the two Danavas! Deprived of the Vedas, the world I have created have become covered with darkness.

sa: भरद्वाज उवाच अग्नेर्यथा तथा तस्य यदि नाशो न विद्यते। इन्धनस्योपयोगान्ते स चाग्निर्नोपलभ्यते॥
en: Bharadwaja said If there is no destruction of the living creature like that of fire, I say, fire itself is not visible after consumption of the fuel (that ignited it).

sa: यथा वारिचर: पक्षी न लिप्यति जले चरन्। विमुक्तात्मा तथा योगी गुणदोषैर्न लिप्यते॥
en: As a water fowl, though floating on the water, is never drenched by it, similarly the Yogin of freed soul is never sullied by the imperfections of the three qualities,

sa: बुद्धिरात्मा मनुष्यस्य बुद्धिरेवात्मनाऽऽत्मनि। यदा विकुरुते भावं तदा भवति सा मनः॥
en: as on Ordinarily the Understanding is a man's Soul. When the Understanding, by itself, forms ideas (of objects) within itself, it is then called Mind.

sa: ब्राह्मणानां सितो वण: क्षत्रियाणां तु लोहितः। वैश्यानां पीतको वर्णः शूद्राणामसितस्तथा॥
en: The complexion of the Brahmanas was white; that of the Kshatriyas was red; that of the Vaishyas yellow; and that of the Shudras was black.

sa: मनो बुद्धिः स्वभावश्च त्रय एते स्वयोनिजाः। न गुणानतिवर्तन्ते गुणेभ्यः परमागताः॥
en: Mind, Understanding, and Nature,—these three, originate from their own previous states, and acquiring a position higher than the attributes, do not get over those attributes.

sa: भ्राता ज्येष्ठः समः पित्रा भार्या पुत्रः स्वका तनुः। छाया स्वा दासवर्गश्च दुहिता कृपणं परम्॥
en: The eldest brother is like a father to all his younger brother). The wife and the son are one's own body. One's menial servants are his shadow. The daughter is an object of great love.

sa: स्वर्गः प्रकाश इत्याहुनरकं तम एव च। सत्यानृतं तदुभयं प्राप्यते जगतीचरैः॥
en: It has been said that Heaven is Light and that Hell is Darkness. The creatures living in this world may obtain both Heaven and Hell.

sa: वैखानसाः फेनपेभ्यो धर्मं तं प्रतिपेदिरे। वैखानसेभ्यः सोमस्तु ततः सोऽन्तर्दधे पुनः॥
en: From the froth-eating Rishis, this religion was gained by the Rishis, named Vaikhanasas. From the Vaikhanasas Soma got it. Afterwards, it disappeared from the universe.

sa: नारायणात्मको राजन् रुद्राय प्रददौ च तम्। ततो योगस्थितो रुद्रः पुरा कृतयुगे नृप।॥ बालखिल्यानृषीन् सर्वान् धर्ममेतदपाठयत्। अन्तर्दधे ततो भूयस्तस्य देवस्य मायया॥
en: Having received it thus, Brahman gave this religion, which has Narayana for its soul, to Rudra. In the golden age of that ancient Kalpa, Rudra, devoted to Yoga, 0 king, communicated it to all those Rishis called Valkhilyas. Through the illusion of Narayana, it once more disappeared from the universe.

sa: भरद्वाज उवाच अस्माल्लोकात् परो लोकः श्रूयते नोपलभ्यते। तमहं ज्ञातुमिच्छामि तद् भवान् वक्तुमर्हति॥
en: Bharadwaja said Beyond this region there is a region of which we have heard but never seen. I wish to know all about it. You should describe it to me.

sa: ततः प्रावर्तत तदा आदौ कृतयुगं शुभम्। ततो हि सात्वतो धर्मो व्याप्य लोकानवस्थितः॥
en: The age that first began was highly auspicious and came to be called by the name of Krita. In that age, the religion of Sattva existed, in the entire universe.

sa: कृष्ण एव हि लोकानां भावनो मोहनस्तथा। संहारकारकश्चैव कारणं च विशांपते॥
en: It is Krishna who is the protector of the universe and its beguiler. It is He who is the destroyer and the cause, O king.

sa: भूमेरपि गुणं गन्धमाप आददते यदा। आत्तगन्धा तदा भूमिः प्रलयत्वाय कल्पते॥
en: Then water takes up the attribute of earth, viz., scent. When earth becomes shorn of its principal attribute, that element is about to be destroyed.

sa: अरतिः क्रोधचापल्ये भयं नैतानि नारदे। अदीर्घसूत्रः शूरश्च तस्मात् सर्वत्र पूजितः॥
en: Discontent, anger, levity, and fear, do not exist in Narada. He is free from procrastination, and endued with courage. For this he is adored everywhere.

sa: सुखे तेन संयुक्तो रंस्यते ध्यानकर्मणि। गच्छन्ति योगिनो ह्येवं निर्वाणां तन्निरामयम्॥
en: Enjoying such felicity, be continues to find pleasure in the act of meditation. Yogins attain, in this way, to the highly blessed state of Nirvana.'

sa: भीष्म उवाच इति तनानुयुक्तः स तमुवाच महातपाः। महद्वाक्यमसंदिग्धं पुष्कलार्थपदं शुचि॥
en: Bhishma said Thus accosted by Devala, the pure Jaigishavya of austere penances, said those words of great import, fraught with full faith, and deep significance.

sa: आराध्य स महादेवं देवराजमवाप्तवान्। नारदेन तु भक्त्याऽसौ भव आराधित: पुरा॥
en: Having worshipped Mahadeva thus, he acquired the sovereignty of the celestials. Narada also, in days of yore, worshipped the great Bhava with devotion of heart.

sa: आशा श्रद्धा धृतिः शान्तिर्विजितिः संनतिः क्षमा॥ अष्टमी वृत्तिरेतासां पुरोगा पाकशासन।
en: They Hope, Faith, Intelligence, Contentment, Victory, Advancement, Forgiveness. She who is the eighth, viz., Jaya, occupies the foremost place amongst them, O chastiser of Paka.

sa: यः करोत्यनभिसंधिपूर्वकं तच्च निर्गुदति यत्पुराकृतम्। नाप्रियं तदुभयं कुतः प्रियं तस्य तज्जनयतीह सर्वतः॥
en: People blame a person who is possessed of lust, envy, and other evil passions). Those vices draw the person down in his next life into various sorts of inferior births.

sa: अग्निदाहेन चोरैर्वा राजभिर्वा हृतं धनम्॥ दृष्ट्वा द्वेषात् प्राहसन्त सुहृत्सम्भाविता ह्यपि।
en: Even the friends of the victims, seeing the latter deprived of riches in fire or by robbers or by the king, have begun to jeer.

sa: कुद्दालं दात्रपिटकं प्रकीर्णं कांस्यभाजनम्। द्रव्योपकरणं सर्वं नान्ववैक्षत् कुटुम्बिनी॥
en: Their spades, domestic knives, baskets and dishes and cups of white brass, and other utensils lay scattered in their houses.

sa: शाकल्यः संशितात्मा वै नववर्षशतान्यपि। आराधयामास भवं मनोयज्ञेन केशव॥
en: Shakalya, too, of controlled soul worshipped Bhava in a mental sacrifice that he celebrated for nine hundred years, O Keshava.

sa: अनेर्भार्याऽपि भर्तारं संत्यज्य ब्रह्मवादिनी। नाहं तस्य मुनेर्भूयो वशगा स्यां कथंचन॥
en: The wite of Atri, who was wellread in the Vedas, forsook her husband in anger and said I shall 110 longer live under that ascetic.

sa: अशरीरः शरीरेषु सर्वेषु निवसत्यसौ। वसन्नपि शरीरेषु न स लिप्यति कर्मभिः॥
en: Though shorn of body, He lives in every body. Though living, again, in bodies He is never touched by the acts done by those bodies.

sa: कुशोच्चयनिषण्णः सन् कुशहस्तः कुशैः शिखी। कुशैः परिवृतस्तस्मिन् मध्ये छन्नः कुशैस्तथा॥
en: Sitting on Kusha grass, with Kusha in hand, and binding his hairs with Kusha, he should surround himself with Kusha and have Kusha for robes.

sa: न चाहङ्कारयोगेन मनः प्रस्थापयेत् क्व चित्। न चार्थग्रहणे युक्तो नावमानी न चाक्रियः॥
en: He never, out of selfishness, fixes his mind on anything. Without being engaged in the acquisition of wealth, he abstains also from disregarding or insulting others, but not from work.

sa: विशोकता सुखं धत्ते धत्ते चारोग्यमुत्तमम्॥ आरोग्याच्च शरीरस्य स पुनर्विन्दते श्रियम्।
en: Want of sorrow carries happiness with it, and also health which is a superior possession. Again, on account of this health, one may acquire prosperity.

sa: अनिश्चयो हि युद्धेषु द्वयोर्विवदमानयोः। एकः प्राप्नोति विजयमेकश्चैव पराजयम्॥
en: When two persons fight, victory is indeed doubtful. One of the two surely becomes victorious, and the other is defeated.

sa: मौने ज्ञानफलावाप्तिर्दानेन च यशो महत्। वाग्मित्वं सत्यवाक्येन परत्र च महीयते॥
en: By practising gifts one acquires great fame. By observing truthfulness of speech, one acquire the fit of eloquence and comes to be respected in heaven.

sa: श्रीरुवाच न मां विरोचनो वेद नायं वैरोचनो बलिः। आहुर्मी दुःसहेत्येवं विधिति च मां विदुः॥
en: Virochana did not know, me, His son this Vali knows me not. The learned called me by the name of Dusshaha (born with difficulty). Some knew me by the name of Vidhitsa (desire for action).

sa: तपांसि यानि चीर्णानि चरिष्यन्ति च यत् तपः। शतैः शतसहस्रैश्च तैः सत्यान्न विशिष्यते॥
en: All the penances that have been practised by you and all those that you will practised in the future of hundreds and thousands of years are more cfficacious than truth.

sa: देवराजेन च पुरा कथितैषा कथा शुभा। समस्तेभ्यः प्रशस्तेभ्यो विप्रेभ्यो वसुधाधिप।॥
en: The king of the gods, having acquired it thus from Narada, recited this blessed history to an assembly of all the foremost Brahmanas, O king.

sa: व्याधितो वा कृशो वाऽपि तस्मिन् नाभृन्नरः क्वचित्। सुदक्षिणो मधुरवागनसूयुर्जितेन्द्रियः। धर्मात्मा चानृशंसश्च विक्रान्तोऽथाविकस्थनः॥
en: This king was very intelligent, mild in speech, without envy, a master of his passions, of a righteous soul, full of mercy, gifted with prowess, and not given to boasting.

sa: द्विजाः प्रतिग्रहे युक्ता दातारो राजवंशजाः। यदि धर्मः श्रुतो विप्र सहैव फलमस्तु नौ॥
en: Brahmanas follows the duty of acceptance. Persons born in the royal order follow the duty of giving. If you are not unaware of the duties, let our fruits be equal.

sa: ततस्ते कल्पमुत्थाय तस्मै राज्ञे न्यवेदयन्। ब्राह्मणा विस्मिताः सर्वे यदुक्तं चित्रभानुना॥
en: At this, all those Brahmanas were struck with surprise and rising on the morrow, they told the king what had been said by the firegod.

sa: विकृत उवाच धारयामीत्यनेनोक्तं ददानीति तथा मया। नायं मे धारयत्यद्य गच्छतां यन वाञ्छति॥
en: Vikrita said-This one says that he owes me. tell him that what I gave I give away. He does not, therefore, owe me anything, Let him go wherever he likes.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच किं फलं ज्ञानयोगस्य वेदानां नियमस्य च। भूतात्मा च कथं ज्ञेयस्तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said What are the fruits of the Jnana Yoga, of all the Vedas, and of the (various) observances and vows? How also may the individual soul be known? Tell me this, O grand father.

sa: यथा च देहाच्च्यवते शरीरी पुनः शरीरं च यथाभ्युपैति। मनुरुवाच स्तदेव दुःखं प्रवदन्त्यनिष्टम्।
en: What is agreeable to one constitutes his happiness. Likewise what is disagreeable to one forms his misery, feeling-"By this I shall acquire happiness and prevent misery”_-men perform all religious acts.

sa: यद् यच्छरीरेण करोति कर्म शरीरयुक्तः समुपाश्नुते तत्। शरीरमेवायतनं सुखस्य दुःखस्य चाप्यायतनं शरीरम्॥
en: Whatever acts are perforined by means of the body, one enjoys the fruits thereof in this body. The body is, indeed, the structure to which adhere both happiness and misery.

sa: हरिश्चन्द्रक्रतौ देवांस्तोषयित्वाऽऽत्मतेजसा। पुत्रतामनु सम्प्राप्तो विश्वामित्रस्य धीमतः॥
en: Having pleased the gods at a sacrifice Harishchandra became a son of the wise Vishvamitra.

sa: कुलपतिरुवाच न शक्यमिह शूद्रेण लिङ्गमाश्रित्य वर्तितुम्। आस्यतां यदि ते बुद्धिः शुश्रूषानिरतो भव॥ शुश्रूषया पराँल्लोकानवाप्स्यसि न संशयः॥
en: The Kulapati said It is impossible that a Shudra should live here following the life of Renunciation. If it pleases you, you may stay here and serve us. Forsooth, by such service you shall acquire many regions of great happiness.

sa: प्रणीतं कर्मणा मार्ग नीयमानः पुनः पुनः। प्राप्नोत्ययं कर्मफलं प्रवृत्तं धर्ममाप्तवान्॥
en: Continually driven along the path that is created by acts, he reaps the fruit of his acts for his having followed the practice of acts.

sa: अव्यक्तस्येह विज्ञाने नास्ति तुल्यं निदर्शनम्। यत्र नास्ति पदन्यासः कस्तं विषयमाप्नुयात्॥
en: There is no indication that which can give a knowledge of the Unseen. That which cannot be described in language, cannot be acquired by anyone.

sa: ऋचीक उवाच किं प्रयच्छामि राजेन्द्र तुभ्यं शुल्कमहं नृप। दुहितुर्ब्रह्यसंसक्तो माऽभूत् तत्र विचारणा॥ चन्द्ररश्मिप्रकाशानां हयानां वातरंहसाम्। एकतः श्यामकर्णानां सहस्रं देहि भार्गव॥
en: Richika said What dower, O king, shall I offer you for the hand of your daughter? Tell me truly, without any hesitation whatsoever! Gadhi said, O Descendant of Bhrigu, give me a thousand horses quickcoursing as the wind, and possessing the colour of moonbeams, and each having one ear black.

sa: अङ्गुष्ठात् ससृजे ब्रह्मा मरीचेरपि पूर्वजम्। सोऽभवद् भरतश्रेष्ठ दक्षो नाम प्रजापतिः॥
en: From his toe, Brahmana had, even before the birth of Marichi, created a son. That son, O Bharata's chief, was Daksha, the progenitor of creatures.

sa: यो हि शैनेय मित्रार्थे युध्यमानस्त्यजेत् तनुम्। पृथिवीं च द्विजातिभ्यो यो दद्यात् स समा भवेत्।।४९
en: O grandson of Sini, he that casts off this mortal frame in fighting for the cause of friends, becomes equal to him that gives away the earth as a gift to the twice born ones.

sa: न हीदृशमहं भावमवशः प्राप्य केवलम्। यदेवमभिजानामि का व्यथा मे विजानतः॥
en: Having obtained this form of birth I have not been enslaved by it for good. Since I know this, I have no cause for sorrow.

sa: नदत्सु धार्तराष्ट्रेषु विजयस्य रथं प्रति। गाण्डीवस्य च निषि विप्रणष्टे समन्ततः॥
en: And when the Dharitarashtra warriors were roaring before Vijaya's chariot, the din was so great that the twang of the Gandiva could not be heard.

sa: धनूंषि चास्य सज्जानि हेमपृष्ठानि सर्वशः। शोभयन्ति रथश्रेष्ठं शक्रचापमिवाम्बरम्॥
en: And his bows adorned and backed with gold all over, beautify his car even as Indra's bow beautify the firmament.

sa: लोमश उवाच परदारेषु ये सक्ता अकृत्वा दारसंग्रहम्। निराशाः पितरस्तेषां श्राद्धकाले भवन्ति वै॥
en: Lomasha said The departed Manes of those men vho, without having wives of their own know the wives of other people, are disappointed when the time for the Shraddha comes.

sa: वर्तमाने तथा रौद्रे तस्मिन् वीरवरक्षये। अशृणोत् सहसा पार्थः पाञ्चजन्यस्य निःस्वनम्॥
en: When that fight destructive of best and foremost heroes was thus raging with fury, Pritha's son Yudhishthira, suddenly heard the blast of the conch Panchajanya.

sa: अथ सात्यकिमुत्सृज्य त्वरन् कर्णोऽर्जुनं त्रिभिः। विद्ध्वा विव्याध विंशत्या कृष्णं पार्थं पुनः पुनः॥
en: Thereupon Karna, having abandoned Satyaki and penetrated Arjuna with three sharp shafts most activity, pierced Krishna with twenty other arrows; and again, penetrated the son of Pritha often and often.

sa: प्रायश्चित्तं तु यत् तत्र ब्रुवतस्तन्निबोध मे॥ यत् कृत्वा तु नरः सम्यक् सुखी भवति विज्वरः।
en: I shall now recite what the expiation's are which one must perform for purifying himself from such sins. Listen to me with attention. By performing those expiatory rites, one becomes happy and free from fever.

sa: ततस्तस्मादपाक्रम्य सागच्छत् पाकशासनम्। अथ सोऽन्वतपत् पश्चाच्छ्रियं दृष्ट्वा पुरन्दरे॥
en: Deserting the Asura she went to Indra the king of gods. Seeing the goddess living with Purandara, Vali regretted idly.

sa: ये चैनमुपजीवन्ति रमते यैश्च वीर्यतः। तेषां बहुविधं दत्त्वा तानप्यत्र नियोजय॥
en: Giving them immense wealth, do you also send with him those that depend on Rāma, as well as those with whom he delights to wrestle.

sa: तस्माद्धि राजशार्दूल धर्मः श्रेष्ठतरः स्मृतः। स राजा यः प्रजाः शास्ति साधुकृत् पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: Therefore also, O foremost of kings' Dharma has been said to be the highest of all things. That best of men who governs his subjects righteously is called a king.

sa: धनात् स्त्रवति धर्मो हि धारणाद् वेति निश्चयः। अकार्याणां मनुष्येन्द्र स सीमान्तकरः स्मृतः॥
en: Righteousness is called Dharma, because it helps the acquisition and preservation of wealth. The sages, O king, have declared that the Dharma restrains and limits all evils acts of men.

sa: ययाति हुषो राजा पूरूं पुत्रं कनीयसम्। राज्येऽभिषिच्य मुदितः प्रवव्राज वनं तदा॥ अन्त्येषु स विनिक्षिप्य पुत्रान् यदुपुरोगमान्। फलमूलाशनो राजा वने संन्यवसचिरम्॥
en: The son of Nahusha, king Yayati, having installed his youngest son Puru on the throne, went to the forest to lead the life of a recluse. He passed over the claims of his other sons with Yadu at their head and he lived in the forest on fruits and roots.

sa: सवेपथून् हयान् पश्य महाकायान् महाजवान्॥ प्लवमानान् दर्शनीयानाकाशे गरुडानिवा
en: See, your beautiful and large horses endued with great speed resembling the beautiful Garuda in the sky, are also trembling.

sa: अथ भूमिप्रदेशज्ञाः सूत्रकर्मविशारदाः। स्वकर्माभिरताः शूराः खनका यन्त्रकास्तथा॥ कर्मान्तिकाः स्थपतयः पुरुषा यन्त्रकोविदाः। तथा वर्धकयश्चैव मार्गिणो वृक्षतक्षकाः॥ सूपकाराः सुधाकारा वंशचर्मकृतस्तथा। समर्था ये च द्रष्टारः पुरतश्च प्रतस्थिरे॥
en: Then set out in advance persons having a knowledge of the humidity or otherwise of the soil, men skilled in making tents, brave delivers engaged on their proper work; those capable of constructing canals and water courses, people on pay, car-makers, men preparing machines, carpenters, those intended to guard the ways, pioneers, cooks, perfumers, makers of wickerware and able guides.

sa: द्रौपदेया धार्तराष्ट्रशिष्टान् सह शिखण्डिना। ते ते च तांस्तानहितानस्माकं मन्तु मामकाः॥
en: Let the sons of Draupadi, with Shikhandin proceed against the remaining sons of Dhritarashtra. Let the other heroes proceed against the rest of our enemies.

sa: पार्थ नेदं त्वया शक्यं पुरं जेतुं कथंचन। उपावर्तस्व कल्याण पर्याप्तमिदमच्युत॥
en: "O Partha, this country cannot be conquered by you. If you seek your good return from this place. O Achyuta, your conquests are already enough.

sa: दानं दाक्ष्यं श्रुतं शौर्यं ह्रीः कीर्तिर्बुद्धिरुत्तमा। सन्नतिः श्रीकृतिस्तुष्टिः पुष्टिश्च नियताच्युते॥
en: Liberality, cleverness, knowledge of the Shruti (Veda), bravery, modesty, achievements, excellent intelligence, humility, beauty, firmness, contentment and prosperity, all live for ever in Achyuta (Krishna).

sa: तदेतन्मुनिशार्दूल धनुः परमभास्वरम्॥ रामलक्ष्मणयोश्चापि दर्शयिष्यामि सुव्रत।
en: And, O puissant ascetic, this highly effulgent bow will I show to Rāma and Laksmana.

sa: असम्भ्रान्तस्तदा कर्णस्तद् रक्षः प्रत्ययुध्यत॥ ततः क्रुद्धो महाराज भैमसेनिर्महाबलः।
en: Karna dauntlessly fought on with him. Thereupon the highly puissant son of Bhima, O king, being worked up with rage.

sa: एवंरूपा मया नारी काचिदन्या महीतले। न दृष्टपूर्वा सुश्रोणि यादृशी त्वमनिन्दिते॥
en: O you of fair hips, never before have I beheld in the world a woman endued with such beauty as you are, O blameless one.

sa: तस्मिन् वर्षे गतप्राये कीचकस्तु महाबलः। सेनापतिविराटस्य ददर्श दुपदात्मजाम्॥
en: That year being nearly expired the mighty Kichaka the commander of Virata's forces happened to see the daughter of Drupada.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा ततोऽगच्छत् समुद्रं सरितां पतिम्। ऋषिभिश्च तपःसिद्धैः सार्धं देवैश्च सुव्रत॥ समुद्रं भीमनिः
en: O vow-observing man, having said this, he then went to the lord of rivers, the ocean, accompanied by the Rishis who had become successful in asceticism and by the celestials.

sa: दृष्ट्वा द्रोणं ततः शूरः सत्यजित् सत्यविक्रमः। युधिष्ठिरमभिप्रेप्सुराचार्यं समुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Then the heroic Satyajit of prowess invincible, beholding Drona thc preceptor desirous of capturing Yudhishthira, rushed at him with fury.

sa: निर्दहन्तमनीकानि तानि तानि पुनः पुनः। द्रोणं मत्स्यादवरजः शतानीकोऽभ्यवर्तत॥
en: Then Shatanika the younger brother of the king of the Matsyas, seeing Drona repeatedly consumne the divisions, rushed at him.

sa: तं दहन्तमनीकानि क्रुद्धमग्निं यथा वनम्। दृष्ट्वा रुक्मरथं वीरं समकम्पन्त सुंजयाः॥
en: Beholding that one of the golden car, endued with bravery, excited with wrath, consume their divisions like fire burning down a forest, the Srinjayas trembled.

sa: भीष्म उवाच इत्युक्तः स महेन्द्रेण तपस्वी कोपनो भृशम्। जग्राह पुष्करं धीमान् प्रसन्नश्चाभवन्मुनिः॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed by the king of the celestials, the ascetics viz., Agastya, who had been very angry, took back his stalks. Gifted with intelligence, the Rishi became cheerful.

sa: तं द्रोणः सधनुष्कं तु साश्वयन्तारमाक्षिणोत्। स हतः प्रापतद् भूमौ रथाज्ज्योतिरिवाम्बरात्॥
en: Drona struck him along with his horses, charioteer and bow. Then from his car he fell down dead like a luminary dropped from the heaven.

sa: विषेण संवृतैर्गात्रैर्यावत् त्वां न विमोक्ष्यति। तावत् त्वयि महाराज दुःखं वै स निवत्स्यति॥
en: O foremost of the kings! as long as the person will not leave you, he shall have to miserably reside in yourself with the whole body filled with my poison.

sa: कर्ता त्वं कर्मणो ह्यस्य नाहं वृष्णिकुलाधम॥ पापानां च त्वमावासः कर्मणां मा पुनर्वदा
en: You are the perpetrator of vile acts and not I, O vilest of the Vrishni race. You are the hotbed of sin. Do not again blame this deed of mine.

sa: ततो वातसहां नावं यन्त्रयुक्तां पातकिनीम्। ऊर्मिक्षमा दृढां कृत्वा कुन्तीमिदमुवाच ह॥
en: Thereupon he procured a boat with machinery and flats and which was strong enough to withstand wind and waves. He then spoke to Kunti thus.

sa: महाराज मनुष्येषु निन्द्यं यः सर्वमाचरेत्। स बध्यः सर्वलोकस्य निन्दितानि समाचरन्॥
en: O great king, he, who behaves sinfully in every thing towards men, ought to be killed by the entire world owing to his sinful behaviour.

sa: सोऽवमन्य तथास्माकमनादृत्य च केशवम्। प्रसह्य हृतवानद्य सुभद्रां मृत्युमात्मनः॥
en: By insulting us and disregarding Keshava (Krishna) he has carried away Subhadra by force wishing to compass his own death.

sa: शक्र उवाच कर्तुमर्हसि तद् देव शिरसा त्वां प्रसादये। छन्दोदेव इति ख्यातः स्त्रीणां पूज्यो भविष्यसि॥
en: Shakra said You will be celebrated as the deity of a particular measure of verse and you will get the worship of all women. Your fame, O son, shall become peerless in the three worlds.

sa: अथ वक्ष्यसि मां मौाद् भूयः परुषमीदृशम्॥ गमयिष्यामि बाणैस्त्वां युधि वैवस्वतक्षयम्।
en: If again, out of folly you speak such harsh words to me, I shall dispatch you to the abode of Death with my own arrows.

sa: वञ्चितः पाण्डवः पूर्वमधर्मेण युधिष्ठिरः॥ द्रौपदी च परिक्लिष्टा तथा धर्मेण सात्यके।
en: Pandu's eldest son Yudhishthira was a few years back cheated unfairly (out of his own kingdom) and O Satyaki, Draupadi was also most vilely insulted.

sa: प्रव्राजिता वनं सर्वे पाण्डवाः सह कृष्णया॥ सर्वस्वमपकृष्टं च तथाधर्मेण बालिश।
en: The Pandavas with Krishna their wife were also exiled to the woods and fool, all their possessions were robbed out of them by unrighteous means.

sa: शक्रस्यापि व्यथां कुर्युः संयुगे भरतर्षभ। नैतेषामर्जुनः शक्त एकैकं प्रति वीक्षितुम्॥
en: They are capable even of giving trouble to Shakra himself in battle. Arjuna is not capable even of gazing at any of them by himself.

sa: क्रुद्धा इव मनुष्येन्द्र भुजङ्गाः कालचोदिताः। प्रसर्पमाणा मेदिन्यां ते व्यरोचन्त मार्गणाः॥
en: Then passing through his body those arrows sank into the earth and looked like so many snakes urged on by Death, O foremost of men.

sa: किंकरैः सह रक्षोभिर्यदरक्षन्महद् धनम्। तदगृहणान्मयस्तत्र गत्वा सर्वं महासुरः॥
en: Going there thereat Asura, Maya, took all the great wealth which was guarded by the Takshas and Rakshasas and Kinkaras.

sa: सुरभिरुवाच यदि पुत्रसहस्राणि सर्वत्र समतैव मे। दीनस्य तु सतः शक्र पुत्रस्याभ्यधिका कृपा॥
en: Surabhi said: Though I have thousands of offspring, yet my affection flows equally towards them all. But, O Shakra, I feel greater compassion for one who is weak and honest.

sa: सोऽहं द्रोणं स्वर्गगतं कर्णशल्यावुभौ तथा॥ वृषसेनं महावीर्यं शकुनि चापि सौबलम्। जलसंधं महावीर्यं भगदत्तं च पार्थिवम्॥ सोमदत्तं महेष्वासं सैन्धवं च जयद्रथम्। दुःशासनपुरोगांश्च भ्रातृनात्मसमांस्तथा॥ दौःशासनिं च विक्रान्तं लक्ष्मणं चात्मजावुभौ। एतांश्चान्यांश्च सुबहून् मदीयांश्च सहस्रशः॥ पृष्ठतोऽनुगमिष्यामि सार्थहीनो यथाऽध्वगः।
en: I am now like a moneyless wayfarer and shall follow suit with Drona who has already gone to heaven, with Karna and Shalya, with Vrishasena of great energy, with Shakuni the son of Subala, with Jalasandha of great valour, with king Bhagadatta, with Somadatta's son that mighty bowman, with Jayadratha the king of the Sindhuas, with all my brothers headed by Dusshasana and equal unto myself, with Dussasana's son of great prowess, and with Lakshmana my son, and thousands of others that fought for me.

sa: विनाशं पश्यमानो हि सर्वराज्ञां गदाग्रजः॥ एतच्छ्रेयस्तु परमममन्यत जनार्दनः।
en: The eldest brother of Gada foresaw the destruction of all the king; Janardana, however, considered that destruction as highly beneficial.

sa: एतत् सर्वं समाज्ञाय बलाग्यं मम भारत। न्यूनतां पाण्डवानां च न मोहं गन्तुमर्हसि॥
en: O lord, knowing well all this the superiority of my army, O Bharata; and the inferior number of the Pandavas, it is not proper that you should lose your senses.

sa: अनेकशो वध्यमानाः कुम्भकर्णेन वानराः। राघवं शरणं जग्मुर्व्यथिता भित्रचेतसः॥
en: Having innumerable monkeys slain by Kumbhakarņa, the monkeys, aggrieved and their hearts riven with sorrow, sought the shelter of Raghava.

sa: तेषां कथयतामेव पुरुषोऽर्जुनसंकथाः॥ उपायाद् वचनाद् दूतो विजयस्य महात्मनः।
en: While they were still engaged in talking about Arjuna a messenger came from that great hero bearing message from him.

sa: क्ज्री महेन्द्रस्त्रिदशेश्वरो वा साक्षाद् यमो वा वरुणोऽनिलो वा। रौद्रोऽग्निरर्को धनदश्च सोमो न वानरोऽयं स्वयमेव कालः॥ किं ब्रह्मणः सर्वपितामहस्य लोकस्य धातुश्चतुराननस्य। इहागतो वानररूपधारी रक्षोपसंहारकरः प्रकोपः॥ किं वैष्णवं वा कपिरूपमेत्य रक्षोविनाशाय परं सुतेजः। अचिन्त्यमव्यक्तमनन्तमेकं स्वमायया साम्प्रतमागतं वा॥ इत्येवमूचुर्बहवो विशिष्टा रक्षोगणास्तत्र समेत्य सर्वे। सप्राणिसङ्घ सगृहां सवृक्षा दग्धां पुरी तां सहसा समीक्ष्य॥
en: Either the thunder-bolt-bearing Indra the Great-chief of celestials, or Yama himself, or Varuna, or the Wind-god, or the Fire generated by Rudra's third eye, or the Sun, or Dhanda, or Soma. This is no monkey, this is verily Kāla (A name of Yama) himself or is this the Rākşasa annihilating Fire or Brahmä himself, the Great sire of all, the four-faced Disposer of the world's destinies, come hither, wearing the form of a monkey? Or is this Visnu's Energy, inconceivable, unutterable, infinite and sole, and of surpassing power, now come hither in its own illusory nature, assuming a monkey-form?" Seeing that city suddenly consumed, with her souls, dwellings, and trees, Raksasas of note, assembled together, thus talked to each other.

sa: मुञ्चैनं भीष्म पश्यन्तु यावदेनं नराधिपाः। मत्प्रभावविनिर्दग्धं पतङ्गमिव वह्निना॥
en: "O Bhishma, release his. Let all these kings see him burnt down by my prowess like an insect by fire".

sa: कपिशोणितदिग्धाङ्ग भक्षयन्तं महाकपीन्। कुम्भकर्णं स्थितं दृष्ट्वा सुग्रीवो वाक्यमब्रवीत्।५४।।
en: Seeing Kumbhakarņa, with his body laved in the blood of monkeys; and eating up mighty monkeys, Sugriva addressed him, saying.

sa: कार्यमित्येव यत् कर्म नियतं क्रियतेऽर्जुन। सङ्गत्यक्त्वा फलं चैव स त्यागः सात्त्विको मतः॥
en: The abandonment of attachment and the fruit of actions which are performed because they are prescribed in the Shastras. O Arjuna, is considered to be of the quality of Sativa.

sa: व्यायाम मुष्टिभिः कृत्वा तलैरपि समागतैः। अपारयंश्च तद् भूतं निश्चेष्टमगमं महीम्॥
en: At first we dealt blows and then gave slaps; but unable to crush him, I (at last) fell down on the ground deprived of sensation.

sa: एक एव तु राजर्षिर्हरिश्चन्द्रो महामुने। कथितस्ते सभायां वै देवेन्द्रस्य महात्मनः॥
en: O great Rishi, you have said that one king namely the royal sage Harishchandra, is in the Sabha of the illustrious lord of the celestials.

sa: दुःखमित्येव यत् कर्म कायक्लेशभयात् त्यजेत्। स कृत्वा राजसं त्यागं नैव त्यागफलं लभेत्॥
en: When work is abandoned from bodily fear and froin the consideration of pain, such abandonment arises from Raja, and one who makes such abandonment never obtains the fruit of Tyaga.

sa: येन केनचिदाच्छन्नो येन केनचिदाशितः। यत्र क्वचन शायी च तं देवा ब्राह्मणं विदुः॥
en: The gods know him for a Brahmana who puts on whatever comes by the way, who lives upon whatever he gets, and who sleeps on what ever spot he finds.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमाख्याय पार्थेभ्यो नारदो जनमेजय। जगाम तैर्वृतो राजनृषिभिर्यैः समागतः॥
en: Vaishampayana said O Janamejaya, O king, having said this to the son of Pritha, Narada went away with those Rishis with whom he had come.

sa: शूद्रकर्मस्वथैतेषु यो भुङ्क्ते निरपत्रपः। अभोज्यभोजनं भुक्त्वा भयं प्राप्नोति दारुणम्॥ कुलं वीर्यं च तेजश्च तिर्यग्योनित्वमेव च। स प्रयाति यथा श्वा वै निष्क्रियो धर्मवर्जितः॥
en: And those who foolishly partake of food offered at ceremonials in a Shudra's house, suffer from a dreadful disaster. On account of partaking such forbidden food, they loose their family strength and energy, and acquire the status of lower animals degenerating to the position of dogs fallen in virtue and devoid of all religious observances.

sa: दृष्ट्वा शारद्वतं पार्थो मूच्छितं शरपीडितम्। रथ एव महेष्वासः सकृपं पर्यदेवयत्॥
en: (Then), seeing the son of Saradvat faint away and afflicted with arrows, the mighty bowman Partha, (seated) on his car, gave way to doleful cries.

sa: कुलान्तकरणे पापे जातमात्रे सुयोधने। नीयतां परलोकाय साध्वयं कुलपांसनः॥
en: As soon as the destroyer of his race, the vile Suyodhana was born, Make away this destroyer of your race.

sa: आचार्य शरवर्षेण रथे सादयता कृपम्। यत् तत् पूर्वमुपाकुर्वन्नत्रं मामब्रवीत् कृपः॥
en: In as much as I have overpowered my preceptor with showers of arrows. Formerly when teaching me the science of weapons, Kripa said to me.

sa: किं पुनद्रौपदेयाभ्यां सहितः सात्वतर्षभः। न च तावत् क्षमः पार्थ तव कर्णेन सङ्गरः॥
en: (And), much more son, since this most exalted of the Satvatas is joined by the two sons of Drupada. O Partha, you need (therefore, not fight with Karna at present.

sa: गते च तमिन्सुरराजशत्रुः क्रोधात्प्रदुद्राव रणाय भूयः। अनायुधोऽस्मीति विचिन्त्य रौद्रो घोरं तदा मुद्गरमाससाद॥
en: Sugrīva having thus escaped, that dreadful enemy of the king of the celestials in wrath again rushed to battle; and finding himself destitute of arms took up a fearful mace.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अहो धर्मिष्ठता तात वृत्रस्यामिततेजसः। यस्य विज्ञानमतुलं विष्णोर्भक्तिश्च तादृशी॥
en: How great was the love of virtue possessed by Vritra of incomparable energy, whose knowledge was incomparable and whose devotion to Vishnu was so great.

sa: तस्माद् भरस्व दुष्यन्त पुत्रं शाकुन्तलं नृप। अभूतिरेषा यत् त्यक्त्वा जीवेजीवन्तमात्मजम्॥
en: O king, O Dushyanta, therefore, cherish your this son, born of Shakuntala. To forsake one's own son and to live thereafter is a great misfortune.

sa: अथ शृङ्ग समाविध्य भीमं भीमपराक्रमः। चिक्षेप राममुद्दिश्य बलवानन्तकोपमः॥
en: That redoubtable one possessed of dreadful prowess, resembling the Reaper himself, whirling a mighty mountain-peak, hurled it aiming at Rāma.

sa: बाहुभ्यामुद्धरेद् भूमि दहेत् क्रुद्धः इमा प्रजाः। पातयेत् त्रिदिवाद् देवान् योऽर्जुनं समरे जयेत्॥
en: He who will lift up the earth on his two arms, or consume all creatures with his wrath of hurl down the gods from heaven, may defeat Arjuna in battle.

sa: स वारिधारा इव सायकांस्तान् पिबशरीरेण महेन्द्रशत्रुः। जघान रामस्य शरप्रवेगं व्यविध्य तं मुद्गरमुग्रवेगम्॥
en: Drinking up in his body those arrows resembling a shower, the enemy of the great Indra whirling his mace possessed of fierce ventinence, put out the arrowy discharge of Rāma.

sa: तं तस्य बाहुं सहतालवृक्षं समुद्यतं पन्नगभोगकल्पम्। ऐन्द्रास्त्रयुक्तेन जघान रामो बाणेन जाम्बूनदचित्रितेन ॥
en: Thereupon with a shaft plated in gold, set upon a weapon of Indra, Rāma cut off his uplifted arm with a palm tree, looking like the body of a pannaga.

sa: दुष्यन्त उवाच न पुत्रमभिजानामि त्वयि जातं शकुन्तले। असत्यवचना नार्यः कस्ते श्रद्धास्यते वचः॥ मेनका निरनुक्रोशा बन्धकी जननी तव। यया हिमवतः पृष्ठे निर्माल्यमिव चोज्झिता॥
en: Dushyanta said : O Shakuntala, I do not know that I begot this child on you. Women generally speak falsehood. Who will believe your words? Your mother is lewd Menaka, destitute of affection; she cast off you in the valley of the Himalayas as one casts off the flowers after offering them to the gods.

sa: न वाससां न रामाणां नापां स्पर्शस्तथाविधः। शिशोरालिङ्ग्यमानस्य स्पर्शः सूनोर्यथा सुखः॥
en: The touch of the sandal-paste, that of women and water, is not so pleasing as that of one's own infant son, locked in his embrace.

sa: भरतश्चापि तान् दूतानेवमुक्तोऽभ्यभाषत। आपृच्छेऽहं महाराजं दूताः संत्वरयन्ति माम्॥
en: Thus addressed, Bharata said to the envoys, “Let me tell the king that the envoys are urging speed on me.”

sa: यमो वैवस्वतस्तस्य निर्यातयति दुष्कृतम्। हृदि स्थितः कर्मसाक्षी क्षेत्रज्ञो यस्य तुष्यति॥
en: Yama, the son of Vivasvata, takes no account of the sins of that man with whom the Deity, the witness of all acts, remains pleased.

sa: दुःखेन श्लिष्यते भिन्नं श्लिष्टं दुःखेन भिद्यते। भिन्ना श्लिष्टा तु या प्रीतिर्न सा स्नेहेन वर्तते॥
en: It is difficult to unite again two who have been separated, as it is difficult to separate two that are united. If persons, reunited after separation, meet one another again, their conduct cannot be affectionate.

sa: निवेदयित्वा ते सर्वे आश्रमं पुनरागताः। पूजयित्वा यथान्यायमब्रवीच शकुन्तला॥
en: The disciples of the Rishi, having told the king everything, returned to the hermitage. And Shakuntala, after duly worshipping the

sa: सा सखीभिः परिवृता दिव्याभरणभूषिता। चंक्रम्यमाणा वल्मीकं भार्गवस्य समासदत्॥
en: Surrounded by her companions and adorned with beautiful ornaments, she came to the anthill within which Bhrigu's son was seated.

sa: एष शूरच वीरश्च क्रोधनश्च वृकोदरः। निरपेक्ष शरीरे च प्राणतश्च बलाधिकः॥
en: This Vrikodara is heroic, brave and wrathful. He does not care for any while protecting his body and is superior to all in vital strength.

sa: प्राप्तोऽहं स हि धर्मात्मा सुग्रीवः सख्यमिच्छति। तस्य मां सचिवं वित्तं वानरं पवनात्मजम्॥ भिक्षुरूपप्रतिच्छन्नं सुग्रीवपियकारणात्। ऋष्यमूकादिह प्राप्तं कामगं कामचारिणम्॥
en: That virtuous souled Sugrīva desires to make friends with you. And know me to be his counsellor-a monkey, the son of Pavana, ranging every where at my will, coming here, under the guise of a mendicant, from the mount Rsymuka, for the welfare of Sugriva.

sa: स त्वं पुरुषशार्दूल त्रैलोक्यस्याभिपालनात्। लक्ष्मणेन विना चाद्य जगत्स्वस्थं कुरुष्व ह॥
en: Therefore, O foremost of men, do you protect, the universe by suffering separation from Lakşmaņa, in the interest of the preservation of the three worlds.

sa: अक्रुध्यत् स तया विद्धे नेत्रे परममन्युमान्। ततः शर्यातिसैन्यस्य शकृन्मूत्रे समावृणोत्॥
en: His eyes being thus pierced, he felt great pain and became very angry. He then stopped the calls of nature of the troops of Sharyati.

sa: ततः पावकसंकाशं वधाय समरे शरम्। खरस्य रामो जग्राह ब्रह्मदण्डमिवापरम् ॥
en: Then with the view of bringing about (Khara's end) Rāma took up in the conflict an arrow resembling fire or another weapon of Brahmã himself.

sa: यतो गृहीत्वा हि करोति यच्च यस्मिश्च तामारभते प्रवृत्तिम्। यस्मिश्च यद् केन च यश्च कर्ता यत् कारणं ते समुदायमाहुः॥
en: It has been said that which is the Cause of the actor, the act, the material with which the act is done, the place and the time of the act, and the inclinations and propensities about happiness and misery, is called the Self (or Soul).

sa: सर्वेषां समतिक्रम्य राक्षसेन्द्रस्य वीर्यवान्। आससादाथ लक्ष्मीवान् रावणस्य निवेशनम्॥
en: Having passed the dwellings of all, that powerful and auspicious one approached the residence of the lord of Rākşasas, Rāvaņa.

sa: द्रव्यवान् गुणवानेव त्यागी भवति सात्त्विकः। पञ्च भूतानि पञ्चभ्यो निवर्तयति तादृशः॥
en: The godly man of possessions and virtues, who wants to be thus endued with virtue, should turn away his five senses from their five objects.

sa: न दुष्करमिदं पुत्र यत् प्रभुर्घातयेत् परम्। श्लाघनीया यशस्या च लोके प्रभवतां क्षमा॥
en: It is not at all difficult, O son, for a master to put his servant to death. Forgiveness, however, in persons endued with power, is always praiseworthy and yields fame.

sa: क्रोधाविष्टेषु पार्थेषु धार्तराष्ट्रेषु चाप्यति। द्रौपदी: पाण्डुपुत्राणां कृष्णा शान्तिरिहाभवत्॥
en: When the sons of Pandu and Dhritarashtra were excited with anger, this Krishna, the daughter of Drupada, become their salvation.

sa: यथैव कुन्त्या कौन्तेया रक्षितव्यास्तथा मया। तथैव धृतराष्ट्रेण रक्षितव्या यथा त्वया॥
en: I know that I should protect the Pandavas with as much care as Kunti does, and that Dhritarashtra also should protect them as I should.

sa: द्विजेष्वकोपं पितृतः प्रसाद शतं सुतानां परमं च भोगम्। कुले प्रीतिं मातृतश्च प्रसाद शमप्राप्तिं प्रवृणे चापि दाक्ष्यम्॥
en: I pray from you uniform affection for the Brahmanas, the favour of my father, a hundred sons, the highest enjoyments, love for my family, the favour of my mother, the attainment of tranquility and peace, and cleverness in every deed.

sa: कथं द्रक्ष्यामि कौन्तेयं सौभद्रे निहतेऽर्जुनम्। सुभद्रां वा महाभागां प्रियं पुत्रमपश्यतीम्॥
en: Oh, now that Abhimanyu is slain, how shall I look upon Kunti's son Arjuna or upon the auspicious Subhadra bereft of her that dearloved son!

sa: अधिकं शैलराजोऽयं धातुभिस्तु विभूषितः। विचित्रं सृजते रेणुं वायुवेगविघट्टितम्॥
en: This prince of mountains, beautified with various metals, has been throwing up dusts of diverse colours driven by the wind.

sa: भीष्म उवाच क्षुधितस्य मृगेन्द्रस्य भोक्तुमभ्युत्थितस्य च। भोजनायोपहर्तव्यं तन्मांसं नोपदृश्यते॥ मृगराजेन चाज्ञप्तं दृश्यतां चोर इत्युत।
en: Bhishma said Feeling hungry, when the king of beasts came to eat, he did not found the meat which should have been kept ready for his dinner. The king then ordered,-Let the thief be detected!

sa: यदर्थं चाप्यपहृतं येन तच्चैव मन्त्रितम्। तस्य तद् विदितं सर्वं कारणार्थं च मर्षितम्॥
en: The jackal knew who had taken away the meat and the party who were connected with the act. But though he knew everything, he bore it for a particular object.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच सैन्धवैरभवद् युद्धं ततस्तस्य किरीटिनः। हतशेषैर्महाराज हतानां च सुतैरपि॥
en: There took place a great battle between the diadem decked Arjuna and the hundreds of Saindhavas who still lived after the destruction of their clan.

sa: भवतश्च प्रियं यत् स्यादस्माकं च यशस्करम्। वयमेनं हनिष्यामो निकृश्यायोधनाद् बहिः॥
en: This act will be agreeable to you and shall redound to our renown. Drawing him out of the field of battle we shall slay him.

sa: प्रभवन्तं पदस्थं हि परुषं कोऽभिभाषते। पण्डितः शास्त्रतत्त्वज्ञो विना प्रोत्साहनेन वा॥
en: Who that is wise and learned, ever address him roughly that is at once puissant and of (high) station, if not to spur him on?

sa: गदां युयुत्समानस्य कालस्येवेह संजय। न हि पश्याम्यहं युद्धे यस्तिष्ठेदग्रतः पुमान्॥
en: I do not, O son, find that warrior who can stand before Bhima when in battle with his mace uplifted, he stands like Death incarnate.

sa: दैवेनाक्रम्यते सर्वं दैवं हि परमा गतिः। तस्य मे परमार्तस्य प्रसादमभिकाङ्क्षतः। कर्तुमर्हसि भद्रं ते दैवोपहतकर्मणः॥
en: Density overtake all: Destiny is the prime way. Therefore it behove you to grant your favour to me extremely distressed, who crave your favour, and, good betide you, whole endeavours have been baffled by Density.

sa: सोऽहं द्वितीयं काकुत्स्थ न वक्ष्यामीति चोत्तरम्। मा द्वितीयेन दण्डो वै निपतेन्मयि मानद॥
en: And, O Kākutstha, a second answer I would not return; so that, О bestower of honour, I may not, by a second reply, render myself liable to a fresh punishment.

sa: ततोऽभिषेको ववृधे शत्रुघ्नस्य महात्मनः॥ संप्रहर्षकरः श्रीमानराघवस्य पुरस्य च।
en: And then commenced the auspicious sprinkling of the high-souled Satrughna, gladdening (the hearts of all in) the palace of Rāghava.

sa: अयं शरस्त्वमोघस्ते दिव्यः परपुरंजयः। अनेन लवणं सौम्य हन्तासि रघुनन्दन ॥
en: O captor of hostile capitals, this divine arrow never missing is your. With this, O son of Raghu, you, O spliced one, with slay Lavana.

sa: य इमामखिलां भूमि शिष्यादेको महीपतिः। तस्याप्युदरमेकं वै किमिदं त्वं प्रशंससि॥
en: That matchless king who will govern this unbounded Earth, will have but one stomach. Why do you then speak highly of this course of life?

sa: इति ब्रुवाणं मद्रेश कर्णः प्राहातिमन्युना। पश्य संशप्तकैः क्रुद्धैः सर्वतः समभिद्रुतः॥
en: Thereupon Karna in anger said to the king of Madras who had spoken thus. "See Partha is being assailed on all sides by the Samsaptakas.

sa: ततः सर्वा नरेन्द्रस्य कैकेयीप्रमुखाः स्त्रियः। रुदत्यः शोकसंतप्ता निपेतुर्गतचेतनाः॥
en: Then all the wives of the monarch headed by Kaikeyī, burning with grief and weeping, were well nigh rendered senseless.

sa: रामं शुश्रूष भद्रं ते सुमित्रानन्दवर्धन। रामः सर्वस्य लोकस्य हितेष्वभिरतः सदा॥
en: O you the enhancer of Sumitra's joy-do you attend upon Rāma; may good betide you; Rāma is ever engaged in the welfare of all beings.

sa: संजय उवाच ततः कर्णः कुरुषु प्रदुतेषु वरूथिना श्वेतहयेन राजन्। पाञ्चालपुत्रान् व्यधमत् सूतपुत्रो महेषुभिर्वात इवाभ्रसंघान्॥
en: Sanjaya said O monarch, after the Kurus had been routed (by Arjuna) on whose car were attached white horses, Karna-the son of Suta, like the high wind dispersing the clouds, went on slaughtering the Panchalas.

sa: स तथा ह्रियमाणोऽपि हनूमांस्तेन रक्षसा। आजघाननिलसुतो वज्रकल्पेन मुष्टिना॥
en: Being thus put to shame by that Rākşasa, Hanumăn the son of the Wind, struck him with his iron fist.

sa: ततः सुविद्धाः सरथाः सनागा योधा विनेदुर्भरतर्षभाणाम्। अन्तर्हिता भीष्ममुखाः सहाश्वाः किरीटिना कीर्णरथाः पृषत्कैः॥
en: The warriors of the Bharatas, headed by Bhishma, with their horses, elephants and chariots rendered invisible and pierced and having their cars broken by Kiritin with shafts, began to bewail.

sa: अर्थसिद्धिमनर्थं च जीवितं मरणं तथा। सुखदुःखफले चैव न दृष्मि न च कामये॥
en: I neither dislike nor like success or defeat, regarding the attainment of all objects of desire, life, or death, the fruits of action that are represented by pleasure or pain.

sa: तं शात्रवाणां गणबाधितारं कर्माणि कुर्वन्तममानुपाणि। शत्रुतपः पार्थममृष्यमाण: समार्दयच्छर वर्षेण पार्थम्॥
en: Unable to check his anger, Shatruntapa, with a downpour of shafts, began to afflict Partha-the obstructor of the enemies and the author of superhuman deeds.

sa: आस्येन तु यदाहारं गोवन्मृगयते मुनिः। अथास्य लोकः सर्वोऽयं सोऽमृतत्वाय कल्पते॥
en: The Muni who eats like the kine and other animals, without providing for it beforehand and without any relish, becomes identified with the whole universe.

sa: वर्जयित्वा महातेजा विभीषणगृहं प्रति। क्रममाणः क्रमेणैव ददाह हरिपुङ्गवः॥
en: And leaving alone the dwelling of Vibhişaņa, that exceedingly energetic one-foremost of monkeys-by and by burnt (all the houses there).

sa: देवदानवयक्षाणां लोका ये रक्षसामपि॥ बहुधा निपतिष्यन्ति बाणौधैः शकलीकृताः।
en: The dwellings of the celestials, Asuras, Yaks as and Rākşasas shall fall down sundered by my arrows into diverse pieces.

sa: यदि मे पश्यतः कालो भूतानि न विनाशयेत्। स्यान्मे हर्षश्च दर्पश्च क्रोधश्चैव शचीपते॥
en: If I did not know that it is Time which destroys all creatures, then, perhaps, I would have experienced the emotions of joy, pride and anger, O husband of Shachi.

sa: देवयान्या भुजिष्यास्मि वश्या च तव भार्गवी। सा चाहं च त्वया राजन् भजनीये भजस्व माम्॥
en: O king, I am the slave of Devayani, the lady of the Bhrigu race. You are Devayani's master and lord. Therefore, you are my master and lord as well. I solicit you. Fulfill my wishes.

sa: ततस्त्वयोध्या रहिता महात्मना पुरंदरेणेव मही सपर्वता। चचाल घोरं भयशोकदीपिता सनागयोधाश्वगणा ननाद च॥
en: Like the Earth with her mountains bereft of Purandara, Ayodhya, bereft of Rama, shook, agitated by fear and grief; and the citizens with elephants and warriors uttered exclamations of distress.

sa: स मुहूर्तादुपश्रुत्य देवर्षिरमितप्रभः। स्वमाश्रमं शिष्यवृतः क्षुधातः संन्यवर्तत॥ सोऽपश्यदरजां दीनां रजसा समभिप्लुताम्। ज्योत्स्नामिव ग्रहग्रस्तां प्रत्यूषे न विराजतीम्॥
en: Thereupon having heard everything about Arajă from a disciple, he, surrounded by his pupils, arrived at his own hermitage and beheld her there poorly, soiled with dust and like to the morning rays of the moon possessed by a planet.

sa: अदातारो शरण्याश्च राजकिल्विषभागिनः। दोषाणामेव भोक्तारो न सुखानां कदाचन॥
en: Kshatriyas who do not practise charity and give protection (to others), commit sin. Woe to thein hereafter and not bliss.

sa: कस्माद् भूतानि जीवन्ति प्रवर्तन्ते तथा पुनः। किंवा फलं परं प्राप्य जीवस्तिष्ठति शाश्वतः॥
en: From whom do creatures originate and live? Through whom again do they act? What is that great Fruit by acquiring which a creature succeeds in living for good as Brahma?

sa: इत्युक्त्वा भार्गवो वासमन्यत्र समकारयत्। तच्च राज्यं नरेन्द्रस्य सभृत्यबलवाहनम् ॥ सप्ताहाद्भस्मसाद्भूतं यथोक्तं ब्रह्मवादिना।
en: There upon Sukrācārya went away and lived elsewhere. According to the words of the saint, the entire kingdom of Danda, with servants, army, and conveyances, was destroyed within seven nights.

sa: तथोक्ते तानृषीरामः प्रत्युवाच कृताञ्जलिः। किमाहारः किमाचारो लवणः क्व च वर्तते॥
en: Thus accosted (by the sages), Rāma answered them with joined hands: "What does he live on? What are his ways? And where does Lavana live?"

sa: कौम्भकर्णिस्ततो वीरो निकुम्भो नाम वीर्यवान्। अब्रवीत्परमवुद्धो रावणं लोकरावणम्॥
en: Then that hero, Kumbhakarma's son, named Nikumbha, endowed with exceeding prowess, in high wrath remarked to Rāvana, destroyer of worlds.

sa: तेषामन्योन्यसुहृदां कृते कर्मणि दुष्करे। सिंहनादः प्रहृष्टानां दिविस्पृक् सुमहानभूत्॥
en: Seeing this most difficult feat friends, filled with delight, set up leonine shouts that sceined to reach the very heavens.

sa: ततो वज्रहनुर्नाम राक्षसः पर्वतोपमः॥ क्रुद्धः परिलिहन्सृक्कां जिह्वया वाक्यमब्रवीत्।
en: Then a Raksasa, named Vajrahanu, resembling a hill, in wrath lapping the corners of his mouth with his tongue, said.

sa: तस्य शब्दो महानासीत् परानभिमुखस्य वै। गरुडस्येव पततः पन्नगार्थे यथा पुर॥
en: The great noise made by Arjuna while advancing towards his enemies, was like that of Garuda, in days of yore, while swooping down upon snakes.

sa: तेषामापततां पार्थमारावः सुमहानभूत्। सागरस्येव क्षुब्धस्य यथा स्यात् सलिलस्वनः॥
en: And while rushing against Partha, they raised a tumultuous cry like the roarings of the surging waves in a tempest.

sa: वृत्तो प्रह्मोत्तरो रङ्गः पाञ्चाली ब्राह्मणैर्वृता। इति ब्रुवन्तः प्रययुर्ये तत्रासन् समागताः॥
en: Those that assembled there went away saying that the Brahmanas had become victorious to-day; the princess of Panchala had become the bride of a Brahmana.

sa: एवं ते विनिवृत्तास्तु युद्धाद् युद्धविशारदाः। यथावासं ययुः सर्वे विस्मिता राजसत्तमाः॥
en: Having thus desisted from the battle, those best of monarchs, those (heroes) well (skilled in battle, returned to their respective kingdoms, all becoming exceedingly surprised.

sa: कृते प्रतिकृतं पश्य पश्य बाहुबलं च मे। इति शूरार्थवचनैरभाषेतां परस्परम्॥
en: “Behold the strength of my arms, “Mark how I have counteracted your feats, they addressed each other in such words, intelligible only of the heroes.

sa: ददृशुस्ता महाकायं महावीर्य महाद्युतिम्। रावणं निहतं भूमौ नीलाञ्जनचयोपमम्॥
en: Thereupon they beheld there on the earth the huge-bodied and the highly powerful and effulgent Rävaņa slain like red collyrium.

sa: तथा तु समरे विद्ध्वा राक्षसेन्द्रं घटोत्कचम्। ननाद सुमहानादं द्रोणपुत्रो महारथः॥
en: Having, in that engagement, thus pierced Ghatotkacha, the lord of the Rakshasas, that great car-warrior, the son of Drona sent forth a highly dreadful roar.

sa: तं तु दृष्ट्वा तथावस्थमश्वत्थामानमाहवे। पञ्चाला: संजयाश्चैव सिंहनादं प्रचक्रिरे॥
en: Seeing Ashvatthama in that state, the Panchalas as well as the Srinjayas, in that encounter, sent forth roars like lions.

sa: सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता शत्रुणा शत्रुतापनः। धनुरन्यत् समादाय सात्वतं प्रत्यविध्यत॥
en: That scorcher of foes, (thus) deeply pierced by his powerful antagonist, took up another bow and pierced Satvata in return.

sa: पुनरेवाब्रवीत् प्रीतो राघवं रघुनन्दनम्। अयमाख्याति ते राम सचिवो मन्त्रिसत्तमः॥ हनुमान् यनिमित्तं त्वं निर्जनं वनमागतः।
en: Sugrīva well pleased again addressed Rāghava, the son of Raghu, saying, O Rāma, this servant of thine, foremost of my counsellors, Hanumān, has related (to me), the reason of your arrival in this lone forest.

sa: यथा श्मशाने दीप्तौजाः पावको नैव दुष्यति। एवं विद्वानविद्वान् वा ब्राह्मणो दैवतं महत्॥
en: A fire that blazes forth in a place of cremation is never impure, so is a Brahmana either learned or ignorant is always pure. He is superior to a celestials.

sa: आयत्यां च तदात्वे च श्रेयो राज्ञोऽभिरक्षणम्। जानीषे मम वीर्ये त्वं तव चाहमरिंदम॥
en: At present and in all future periods, it should be your first duty to protect the king. You know my prowess and I all know yours, O Subduer of foe.

sa: सुस्रुवुश्च शकृन्मूत्रं प्रध्यायन्तो विशाम्पते। अन्तर्हिता महानादाः श्रूयन्ते भरतर्षभ॥
en: O foremost of the Bharatas, fierce war-cries of heroes were drowned by the terrible uproar uttered by Rakshasas and cannibals.

sa: रक्षसां पुरुषादानां नदतां भैरवान् रवान्। सम्पतन्तश्च दृश्यन्ते गोमायुबलवायसा॥
en: Jackals, vultures, crows and dogs yelling various shrieks, began, O sire, to pounce and swoop down the ranks of soldiers.

sa: कदा वै प्रस्थिता यूयं किमर्थमिह चागताः। तत् त्वं ब्रूहि यथान्यायं वैदर्भी श्रोतुमिच्छति॥
en: When did you start! What did you come here for? Tell me all the particulars; for the daughter of the king of the Vidharbhas wishes to hear all about these.

sa: सप्तम्यामथवा षष्ठ्यां भक्त्या पूजां करोति यः। अनिविण्णोऽनहंकारी तं लक्ष्मीर्भजते नरम्॥
en: He who reverentially worships you on the sixth or the seventh lunar day with humility of mind obtains the grace of Lakshmi (goddess of wealth.)

sa: अत्र मे महती शङ्का भवेदेष नलो नृपः। यथा च मनसस्तुष्टिर्हदयस्य च निर्वृतिः॥
en: I am greatly afraid, lest this person be king Nala himself. For so great is the satisfaction of my mind, as also the easiness of my heart regarding this matter.

sa: भार्यावियोगजं दुःखं नचिरात् त्वं विमोक्ष्यसे। अहं तामानयिष्यामि नष्टां वेदश्रुतीमिव ॥
en: But you with soon be relieved from the sorrow that comes of separation from one's wife. Her will I bring like to the ravished Devasruti.

sa: रसातले वा वर्तन्ती वर्तन्ती वा नभस्तले। अहमानीय दास्यामि तव भार्यामरिंदम॥
en: O repressor of foes, whether she be in the nether regions or under the sky, I will, bringing your wife, make her over to you.

sa: ततः सुमनसः शेषाः प्रतिगृह्य महात्मनः। पितुः समीपमगमद् देवी श्रीरिव रूपिणी॥
en: Then taking the flowers and garlands with which she worshipped the deity, Savitri looking like the very embodiment of Sri, repaired to her high-souled sire.

sa: ततो विस्फार्य नयने धनुर्ध्यामवमृज्य च। तलशब्दं महत् कृत्वा द्रोणस्तं समुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Thereupon expanding his eyes and twanging his bow-string and making a loud sound by striking his arms with his palms, Drona rushed upon him (Sinhasena).

sa: केषांचिदभवद् भ्राता केषांचिदभवत् सखा। ऋषयस्त्वपरे चैनं पुत्रवत् पर्यपालयन्॥
en: He became the brother of some and the friend of others, the others again treated him as their own son.

sa: स तु कालेन महता प्राप्य निष्कलुषं तपः। ब्रह्मर्षिसदृशः पाण्डुर्बभूव भरतर्षभ।॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, after a long time Pandu acquired those great and sinless ascetic merits, by which he became like a Brahmarshi.

sa: अल्पावशिष्टे सैन्ये तु कौरवेयान् महाहवे। प्रहृष्टाः पाण्डवा भूत्वा निन्यिरे यमसादनम्॥
en: After the Bharata army had bcen reduced to a small number, the Pandavas, filled with delight in that dreadful battle, began to slay the Kauravas.

sa: संजय उवाच सहदेवमथायान्तं द्रोणप्रेप्सु विशाम्पते। कर्णो वैकर्तनो युद्धे वारयामास भारत॥
en: Sanjaya said Karna, the son of Vikartana, O king, checked in battle the great car-warrior Shahadeva who was advancing with the desire of slaying Drona.

sa: स हि धाता विधाता च स प्रभुः सर्वतोमुखः। हृदयं सर्वभूतानां महानात्मा प्रकाशते॥
en: He is the Creator and the ordainer; he is the powerful Lord, with faces turned in all directions. In him, the heart of all creatures, the great soul, becomes resplendent.

sa: कृष्णद्वैपायनं व्यासमासीनमृषिभिः सह। तं चैव क्रूरकर्माणं घृताक्तं कुशचीरिणम्॥ रजसा ध्वस्तमासीनं ददर्श द्रौणिमन्तिके।
en: And he also saw Drona's wicked son sitting by them, covered with dust, clad in a piece of cloth made of Kusha grass, and smeared all over with clarified butter.

sa: भवान् पितृसमो मह्यं धर्मराजसमोऽपि च। तथा कृष्णसमश्चैव सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: You are to me even as my own father or the very virtuous king Yudhishthira or as Krishna himself. This I tell you in sooth.

sa: अथ दुर्योधनं ब्रूया राजपुत्रममर्षणम्। मध्ये कुरूणामासीनमनुनीय पुनः पुनः॥
en: And then speak to the wrathful prince Duryodhana seated in the midst of the Kurus entreating him again and again.

sa: ततः प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा द्रोणं प्रायान्महाभुजम्। परिवृत्तश्च बीभत्सुरगच्छद् विसृजशरान्॥
en: Thereupon leaving the mighty-armed Drona to their right they proceeded onwards; turning his face away, Vibhatsu advanced shooting his shafts.

sa: पञ्चालेषु प्रभग्नेषु क्षीयमाणेषु सर्वतः। जनार्दनो दीनमनाः प्रत्यभाषत फाल्गुनम्॥
en: When the Panchala ranks were broken down and reduced in number, Janaraddana cheerless at heart addressed Phalguna sayingद्रोणकर्णौ महेष्वासावेतौ पार्षतसात्यकी।

sa: तेषु कालपरीतेषु विनश्यत्स्वेव भारत। कालपर्यायमाज्ञाय मा स्म शोके मनः कृथाः॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, their (last) moment having arrived, they would now all perish. Reinembering the changes that are brought by Time, do not grieve.

sa: पुरेव त्रिपुरं दग्ध्वा दिवि देवा महेश्वरः॥ तेषु राजसहस्रेषु पाण्डवेयेषु मारिष।
en: Like the god Maheshvara after he had destroyed Tripura in the days of yore. Among the thousands of king belonging to the Pandavas, O sire.

sa: न ह्यहं तत्र यास्यामि स्थितोऽस्मीति निवेद्यताम्। मत्संश्रयादिमे दूताः सुखिनो भ्रातरो हि मे॥
en: Tell them that I shall not return to where they are, but shall stay even here, since, on account of my companionship, these afflicted brothers of mine have become comforted.

sa: अभ्येत्य सहसा कर्णं द्रोणं च जयतां वरम्। अमर्षवशमापन्नो वाक्यज्ञो वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then quickly approaching Karna and Drona that foremost of victorious heroes and burning with rage, he eloquent in speech, spoke these wordsभवद्भ्यामिह संग्रामः क्रुद्धाभ्यां सम्प्रवर्तितः।

sa: नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम्। देवी सरस्वतीं व्यासं ततो जयमुदीरयेत्।।
en: Having saluted the Supreme Deity (Narayana) and the highest of all male beings (Nara) and also the Goddess of Learning (Sarasvati), let us cry success!

sa: तस्मात् सुभृशमाश्वस्य त्वयि धर्मभृतां वर। कार्ये त्वां विनियोक्ष्यामि तच्छुत्वा कर्तुमर्हसि॥
en: Therefore, O best of virtuous men, greatly relying on you, I shall appoint you to do a certain act. Hearing it, you should do it.

sa: अभिमन्युं महात्मानं व्यात्ताननमिवान्तकम्। द्रोणायाभिमुखं यान्तं के शूराः समवारयन्॥
en: Who resembles Aditya in effulgence, Brihaspati in intelligence-namely, the highsouled Abhimanyu who is like Death himself with a gapping mouth.

sa: श्राद्धं त्वभिजिता कुर्वन् भिषक्सिद्धिमवाप्नुयात्। श्रवणेषु ददच्छ्राद्धं प्रेत्य गच्छेत् स सद्गतिम्॥
en: By doing it under the constellation Abhijit, one acquires great knowledge. By doing it under Shravana, one, after death, attains to a very high end.

sa: अनेन दत्तानि वनीपकेषु भुक्ताश्च भोगा निभृताश्च भृत्याः। धनानि मित्रेषु समर्पितानि वैराण्यमित्रेषु निपातितानि॥
en: By him were conferred many a gift on those who wanted them, were enjoyed many a luxury, were maintained many a servant distributed wealth to friends and slain the enemies.

sa: परदारास्मि भद्रं ते न युक्तं तव साम्प्रतम्। दयिता: प्राणिनां दारा धर्मं समनुचिन्तय॥
en: I am the wife of others; good be to you. This conduct does not become your position. The wives of others are dear to them, think of this axiomatic precept.

sa: यदि पार्थिव कौरव्याञ्जीवमानानिहेच्छसि। दुर्योधनस्तव सुतः शमं गच्छतु पाण्डवैः॥
en: O king, if you wish to keep all the Kurus alive, let your son Duryodhana make peace with the Pandavas.

sa: एकैकशः समर्थाः स्मो विजेतुं सर्वपार्थिवान्। आगच्छन्तु विनेष्यामो दर्पमेषां शितैः शरैः॥
en: Each one of us by himself can conquer all the rulers of the earth. Let them come; we shall curb their pride by sharp arrows.

sa: यमदूतैर्विकृष्यंश्च मृत्यु कालेन गच्छति। वाग्धीनस्य च यन्मात्रमिष्टानिष्टं कृतं मुखे। भूय एवात्मनाऽऽत्मानं बध्यमानमुपेक्षते॥
en: Overcome by his senses, he does good and evil at the every commencement. Having enjoyed or suffered this fruits of these, he again becomes indifferent to his acts of selfdestruction.

sa: यदा कुलीनो धर्मज्ञः प्राणोत्यैश्वर्यमुत्तमम्। योगक्षेमस्तदा राज्ञः कुशलायैव कल्प्यते॥
en: When a high-born and righteous person acquires profuse wealth the king then succeeds in obtaining prosperity in all his works.

sa: उवाच वाक्यं यद् भीमः सभामध्ये विशाम्पते। कृतं तत् सफलं तेन भूयश्चैव करिष्यति॥
en: The words that Bhima spoke in the midst of the assembly have all been nearly fulfilled by him, O monarch. That which remains unaccomplished will again be accomplished by him.

sa: लोकानां स हि सर्वेषां ससुरासुररक्षसाम्। समनुष्योरगवतां कर्ता चैव स भूतकृत्॥
en: Brahman is the Creator of the entire universe with the gods and Asuras and Rakshasas and human beings and snakes, and of every other things.

sa: भीष्म उवाच वेदाहं तव या बुद्धिरानृशंस्यगुणैव सा। न च शुद्धनृशंस्येन शक्यं राज्यमुपासितम्॥
en: Bhishma said 'I know, O Yudhishthira, what the nature of your heart is, and how inoffensive you are. You will not, however, by inoffensiveness alone, succeed in governing your kingdom.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अनागतविधाता च प्रत्युत्पन्नमतिश्च यः। द्वावेव सुखमेधेते दीर्घसूत्री विनश्यति॥
en: Bhishma said 'The two, viz., one, who provides for the future, and one, who has presence of mind—always enjoy happiness. An idle man gains nothing.

sa: यथा ह्यकस्माद् भवति भूमौ पांसुर्विलोलितः। तथैवेह भवेद् धर्मः सूक्ष्मः सूक्ष्मतरस्तथा॥
en: As being pounded between two stones, the dust becomes finer and finer, so questions of morality, the more they are discussed, becomes subtler and subtler.

sa: एतत् ते सर्वमाख्यातं महत्त्वं प्रति राजसु। कात्स्येन भरतश्रेष्ठ किमन्यदिह वर्तते॥
en: I have now told everything about the greatness of kings. What other subject is there, O chief of the Bharatas, which I shall next describe.

sa: नात्र पारं लभते पारगामी महागाधे गौरिव सम्प्रपन्ना। चातुर्वण्र्यं भवति हि सम्प्रमूढं प्रजास्ततः क्षयसंस्था भवन्ति॥
en: No person, desirous of crossing the ocean of life, succeeds in his attempts like a small boat floating on the bosom of the sea. The four orders of men become confounded and meet with destruction,

sa: वासुदेवार्जुनाभ्यां च तानहं परिरक्षितान्। अविषह्यतमान् मन्ये महेन्द्रेणापि सत्तम॥
en: Protected, as they are by Vasudeva, and Arjuna, I consider, them O uncle, as irresistible by the great Indra himself.

sa: स तु लब्धवरः पापो देवानमितविक्रमः। राक्षसस्तापयामास तीव्रकर्मा महाबलः॥
en: Having obtained that boon, the sinful and powerful Rakshasa of terrific deeds and great power began to assail the gods.

sa: तथा स्वलंकृतद्वारं नगरं पाण्डुनन्दनः। स्तूयमानः शुभैर्वाक्यैः प्रविवेश सुहृवृतः॥
en: Accompanied by his friends, and welcomed with sweet words the son of Pandu, entered the city through its well-adorned gate.

sa: एव महर्षयः। भीष्ममामन्त्रयाञ्चक्रू ववौ शिवः सुखो वायुः सर्वगन्धवहः शुचिः। शान्तायां दिशि शान्ताश्च प्रावदन् मृगपक्षिणः॥
en: An auspicious, pleasant and pure breeze, carrying every kind of fragrance, began to blow. All the points of the horizon became clear and quiet, and all the animals and birds began to move about peacefully.

sa: मृत्युर्वा रक्षणं वेति यस्य राज्ञो विनिश्चयः। प्राणद्यूते ततस्तस्य ब्रह्माश्रमपदं भवेत्॥
en: That king, who fights with the object of protecting his kingdom or meeting with death, attains to the object of the Vanaprastha mode of life.

sa: अमित्रा हृष्टमनसः प्रत्युद्यान्ति पलायिनम्। जयिनस्तु नरास्तात चन्दनैर्मण्डनेन च॥
en: Victorious enemies, O Sire, proceed gladly in pursuit of the flying combatants, their praises all the while recited by bards.

sa: कर्णस्तेषामापततामेकैकेन शरेण ह धषि च शरवातान् पातयामास भूतले॥
en: As they thus pursued them, Karna struck down their bows and arrows on the ground, each with a single arrow.

sa: ततः सर्वार्तवं दिव्य पुष्पवर्ष नभस्तलात्। पपात यत्र वार्ष्णेयः सगाङ्गेय सपाण्डवः॥
en: A shower of celestial flowers of all seasons fell on that spot where the Vrishni hero with Ganga's son and the son of Pandu were.

sa: ततः संश्राव्यमाणेषु राज्ञां नामसु भारत। अत्यकामद् धार्तराष्ट्र सा कन्या वरवर्णिनी॥
en: The names of the kings being mentioned to her that fair maiden passed by the son of Dhritarashtra as she had passed others before him.

sa: तेषु तूत्साद्यमानेषु सेनाध्यक्षा महारथाः। भीमसेनं समासाद्य ततोऽयुद्ध्यन्त भारत॥
en: Whilst they were being thus slain, many powerful Kaurava warriors, O Bharata, approached Bhima and began to fight with him.

sa: को नु मामुत्थितं वीर तात तातेति वक्ष्यति। महाराजेति सततं लोकनाथेति तासकृत्॥ परिष्वज्य च मां कण्ठे स्नेहेन किन्नलोचनः। अनुशाधीति कौरव्य तत् साधु वद मे वचः॥
en: Who will now, after I will get up from bed at the proper hour, repeatedly address me in such loving and respectful words as-O father, O father-O great king-O Lord of the world!-and affectionately clasping my neck with tearful eyes, will ask for my orders, saying-Command me, you of Kuru's race!-address me, O son, in that sweet language once inore!

sa: ऋषय ऊचुः शृणुमस्ते वचस्तात पन्थानो विदितास्तव। नियोगे चैव धर्मात्मन् स्थातुमिच्छाम शाधि नः॥
en: The Rishis said We shall hear words, O sire, for you know the different paths! O you of righteous soul, we desire also to obey your behests. Instruct us now!

sa: संसरन्तं प्रजाजालं संयुक्तो ज्ञानचक्षुषा। भीष्म द्रक्ष्यसि तत्त्वेन जले मीन इवामले॥
en: Possessing the eye of knowledge, you will, O Bhishma, see, like fishes in a limpid stream, all created things that you will try to recollect.'

sa: सप्तर्षीन् पृष्ठतः कृत्वा युध्येयुरचला इव। अनेन विधिना शत्रून् जिगीषेतापि दुर्जयान्॥
en: Keeping the constellation called Ursa Major behind them, the troops should fight, standing firmly like hills. By this means, one may defeat even irresistible foes.

sa: पाण्डवाश्च यथा मुक्तास्तथोभौ माधवौ युधि। कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च भारद्वाजस्य चात्मजः॥
en: Tell me how the (five) Pandavas and the two Satvatas (viz., Krishna and Satyaki) and Kripa and Kritavarman and Drona's son, have escaped with life.

sa: तादृशो बध्यते बालो यत्र सत्यमनिष्ठितम्। सत्यानृते विनिश्चित्य ततो भवति धर्मवित्॥
en: That ignorant person commits sin, who says truth which is not righteous. That person is a master of duties who can distinguish truth from untruth.

sa: तत्र कर्णस्य वसतो महेन्द्रे स्वर्गसंनिभे। गन्धर्व राक्षसैर्यक्षैर्देवैश्चासीत् समागमः॥
en: While living on the Mahendra mountains resembling heaven itself, Karna met and mixed with many Gandharvas, and Yakshas, and gods.

sa: पाण्डवास्तु महाराज धृष्टद्युम्नपुरोगमाः। अभ्यद्रवन्त संक्रुद्धास्तव राजन् बलं प्रति॥
en: The Pandavas, O king, with Dhrishtadyumna at their head, worked up with anger, rushed against the residue of your army.

sa: क्षत्रियो वृत्तिसंरोधे कस्य नादातुमर्हति। अन्यत्र तापसस्वाच्च ब्राह्मणस्वाच्च भारत॥
en: When a Kshatriya's means of sustenance are gone, what should he not take excepting what belongs to ascetics and Brahmanas?

sa: पतन्तं तमतिक्रम्य परिजग्राह सात्यकिः। भीमसेनोऽर्जुनश्चैव माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ।॥
en: Going forward, Satyaki clasped the king. Bhimasena and Arjuna and the two sons of Madri also stretched out their arıms.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच यथा जयार्थिनः सेनां नयन्ति भरतर्षभ। ईषद्धर्मं प्रपीड्यापि तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said Tell me, O grandfather, how kings seeking victory should, O foremost of Bharata's race, lead their troops to battle even by acting slightly against the rules of righteousness.

sa: स्वयमेव भवांस्तस्माद् धर्मराजस्य यद्धितम्। तद् ब्रवीत्वाशु सर्वेषामागमानां त्वमागमः॥
en: Do you, therefore, yourself speak for the behoof of king Yudhishthira, for you are the ordainer of all the ordinances.

sa: मौाद येन पिता वृद्धः प्रत्याख्यातो जनार्दन। तथा माता हितं वाक्यं भाषमाणा हितैषिणी॥
en: How can be accept good advice who out of folly, O Janarddana, insolently disobeyed his own old father as also his own good mother who spoke wholesome words to him.

sa: दुःखमषारयन्ती माद्रीसुतस्तत् परिगृह्य वाक्यं धर्मेण धर्मप्रतिमस्य राज्ञः। ययौ रथेनालयमाशु देव्याः पाञ्चालराजस्य च यत्र दाराः॥
en: Following the mandate of the king who was righteous like Yama himself, Nakula speedily proceeded on his car to the palace of Draupadi where that princess lived with all the wives of the Panchala king.

sa: संन्यासकृतबुद्धिः तं भूतानि पितृभिः सह॥ ततो दृष्ट्वा प्ररुरुदुः कोऽस्मान् संविभजिष्यति।
en: Then all creatures with the Pitris, seeing Devala determined to adopt the religion of emancipation began to weep, saying-"Alas, who will hereafter offer us food!'

sa: भीष्म उवाच ब्राह्मणानां यथा धर्मो दानमध्ययनं तपः। क्षत्रियाणां तथा कृष्ण समरे देहपातनम्॥
en: Bhishma said As the duty of the Brahmanas is to practise charity, to study, and perform penances, so the duty of Kshatriyas is to renounce their bodies, OKrishna, in battle.

sa: एकरात्रेण मान्धाता त्र्यहेण जनमेजयः। सप्तरात्रेण नाभागः पृथिवीं प्रतिपेदिरे॥
en: Mandhata conquered the whole word in only one night, Janamejaya, in course of three; and Nabhaga, in course of seven.

sa: तस्मात् त्वमपि सर्वज्ञ धैर्यमालम्ब्य शाश्वतम्। प्रशाधि पृथिवीं कृत्स्ना हतामित्रां नरोत्तम॥
en: Therefore, O you, who are conversant with righteousness, availing of that eternal wisdom, rule the wide world, O monarch, that is now shorn of foes."

sa: दृष्ट्वा तु निहतान् भ्रातॄन् बहूनेकेन संयुगे। अमर्षवशमापन्नः श्रुतर्वा भीममभ्ययात्॥ विक्षिपन् सुमहसचापं कार्तस्वरविभूषितम्। विसृजन सायकांश्चैव विषाग्निप्रतिमान् बहून॥
en: Beholding so many of his brothers killed by Bhima alone in that battle, Shrutarvan, worked up with rage, rushed at Bhima, stretching his dreadful bow docket with gold and discharging a large number of arrows resembling poison or fire. sons

sa: नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम्। देवी सरस्वतीं चैव ततो जयमदीरयेत्।।
en: Having saluted the Supreme Deity (Narayana), and the highest of all male beings (Nara), and also the Goddess of Learning (Sarasvati) let us cry success.

sa: सात्यकिं पञ्चविशत्या भीमसेनं च पञ्चभिः॥ माद्रीपुत्रौ शतेनाजौ विव्याध निशितैः शरैः।
en: And he struck Satyaki with twenty five keen arrows and Bhimasena with seven and the two sons of Madri with a hundred, in the battle.

sa: सोऽहं जीवितमाकाङ्क्षन्नभक्ष्यस्यापि भक्षणम्। व्यवस्ये बुद्धिपूर्वं वै तद् भवाननुमन्यताम्॥
en: Seeking to preserve my life, I wish, with my perfect sense, to eat this impure food. You just order me.

sa: इष्टापूर्तेन दानेन सत्येन च जयेन च। शपे राजन् यथा ह्यद्य निहनिष्यामि सोमकान्॥
en: I swear by all my holy acts, by all the gifts I have made, by truth itself and by my meditations, O king, that I shall today kill the Somakas.

sa: दुर्योधनोऽपि राजेन्द्र शोणितेन परिप्लुतः। तां निशां प्रतिपेदेऽथ सर्वभूतभयावहाम्॥
en: That best of kings, viz., Duryodhana, bathed in blood, began to pass there that night so dreadful to all creatures.

sa: त्वत्तोऽहं दुर्लभं काममनवाप्यैव केशव। प्रतियास्यामि गोविन्द शिवेनाभिवदस्व माम्॥
en: Having failed, O Keshava, to my almost unattainable desire, I wish to leave you, O Govinda! Address me plainly now.

sa: व्यावर्तमाने भगवत्युदीची सूर्ये दिशं कालवशात् प्रपन्ने। गन्तासि लोकान् पुरुषप्रवीर नावर्तते यानुपलभ्य विद्वान्॥
en: Subject to universal time, when the divine Sun turns to his northerly course, you, O foremost of men, shall go to those regions whence no man returns to this Earth.

sa: एते हि देवा वसवो विमार्ना न्यास्थाय सर्वे ज्वलिताग्निकल्पा:। अन्तर्हितास्त्वां प्रतिपालयन्ति काष्ठां प्रपद्यन्तमुदक्पतङ्गम्॥
en: See, those deities and the Vasus, all having fiery forms, riding on their cars, are waiting for you invisibly till the moment of the Sun's entering on his northerly course.

sa: यथा हि रश्मयोऽश्वस्य द्विरदस्याङ्कद्धशो यथा। नरेन्द्रधर्मो लोकस्य तथा प्रग्रहणं स्मृतम्॥
en: As the reins govern the horse or the iron goad the elephant, so the science of royal duties forms the reins for restraining the world.

sa: तं च श्रुत्वा महेष्वासं प्रविष्टं सलिलह्रदे। क्षिप्रमेव ततोऽगच्छन् पुरस्कृत्य जनार्दनम्॥
en: Having learnt that the great bowman Duryodhana had entered into the waters of a lake, the king went there quickly with Janarddana at the head.

sa: तद्वचः संगतं श्रुत्वा लोमशो युक्तमर्थवत्। हर्षादुद्वीक्ष्य पलितं स्वागतेनाभ्यपूजयत्॥
en: Hearing the words of the mouse at that proper time, knowing very useful Lomasha praised him looking with a smile.

sa: सोऽयं मां समनुप्राप्तः प्रत्यक्षं भवतां हि यः। पृथिवीं पालयित्वाऽहमेतां निष्ठामुपागतः॥
en: That death has now come to me, before you all. I, who governed the whole Earth, I have now been reduced to this miserable state.

sa: तेषां लोकेष्वपश्यच जैगीषव्यं स देवलः। अश्वमेधं क्रतुवरं नरमेधं तथैव च॥
en: He then saw him in the regions of those foremost of men that perform the horsesacrifice and the sacrifice in which human beings are killed

sa: अन्नाद् गृहस्था लोकेऽस्मिन् भिक्षवस्तत एव च। अन्नात् प्राणः प्रभवति अन्नदः प्राणदो भवेत्॥
en: They that have food (in their houses) are householders. Mendicants are supported by them. Life is kept up by food. Therefore, the giver of food is the giver of life.

sa: ततोऽग्निहोत्रिणां लोकांस्ततश्चाप्युत्पपात ह॥ दर्श च पौर्णमासं च ये यजन्ति तपोधनाः।
en: Thence he proceeded to the regions of the Agnihotris and thence to the regions of those ascetics that perform the Darsha and the Paurnamasa sacrifices.

sa: असक्तः सक्तवद् गच्छन् निःसङ्गो मुक्तवन्धनः। समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च स वै मुक्तो महीपते॥
en: Unattachment at heart though showing attachment outwardly, standing aloof from the world, having broken all his fetters, regarding friend and foe in the same light, such a man, O king, is regarded to be liberated.

sa: कृतं पापमिदं ब्रह्मन् रोषाविष्टेन चेतसा। वधमाशास्य पार्थानां मयास्त्रं सृजता रणे॥
en: O Rishi, I have, under the influence of anger, done this sinful deed! I invoked this weapon in battle for the destruction of the Pandavas!'

sa: तस्यां द्वादशवार्षिक्यामनावृष्ट्यां महर्षयः॥ वृत्यर्थं प्राद्रवन् राजन् क्षुधार्ताः सर्वतोदिशम्।
en: During that drought extending over twelve years, the great Rishis fled away, O king, on all sides to maintain themselves.

sa: दुष्करं बत कुर्वन्ति महतोऽस्त्यिजन्ति ये। वयं त्वेतान् परित्यक्तुमसतोऽपि न शक्नुमः॥
en: They who can renounce vast wealth achieve a most difficult task. As for ourselves we are unable to renounce that wealth which exists no longer.

sa: त्वनुज्ञाप्य राजानं भृशं शोकपरायणाः। जग्मुर्दूरे महाराज कृपप्रभृतयो रथाः॥
en: Those car-warriors, headed by Kripa, filled with grief, took leave of the king and went away to a remote place.

sa: ते विष्टभ्य सलिलं सुतो धार्तराष्ट्रो महाबलः। पाण्डवाश्चापि सम्प्राप्तास्तं देशं युद्धमीप्सवः॥
en: "Having solidified the waters of the lake, the powerful son of Dhritarashtra lives at tine bed. The Pandavas have reached there from desire of battle.

sa: केचित् पदातयः पद्भिर्मुष्टिभिश्च परस्परम्। निजघ्नुः समरे शूराः क्षीणशस्त्रास्ततोऽपतन्॥
en: Some brave foot-soldiers, destitute of weapons, attacked their foes in that battle, with feet and fists and struck them down.

sa: यः पापं कुरुते राजा काममोहबलात्कृतः। प्रत्यासन्नस्य तस्यर्षे किं स्यात् पापप्रणाशनम्॥
en: If a king, under the influence of lust and folly, commits sin for which he afterwards repents, how, O Rishi, can those sins be destroyed.

sa: दक्षिणेन तु पन्थानं यं भास्वन्तं प्रचक्षते। एते क्रियावतां लोका ये श्मशानानि जिरे॥
en: The path that lies to the south and leads to regions of light is reserved for men devoted to action. These are acquired by persons subject to birth and death.

sa: अरोषस्तव चैवास्तु पार्थाः सन्तु निरामयाः। न ह्यधर्मेण राजर्षिः पाण्डवो जेतुमिच्छति॥
en: Drive away from your heart, and let the Pandavas be self! The royal sage Yudhishthira never wishes to gain victory be perpetrating any sinful act.

sa: भीष्म उवाच हन्त तेऽहं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु कार्यकनिश्चयम्। यथा राज्ञेह कर्तव्यं यच्च कृत्वा सुखी भवेत्॥
en: Bhishma said 'I shall tell you what you wish to know! Hear what should be done in this world by a king and what those works are by doing which a king may become happy.

sa: तस्मिन् मुहूर्ते दशभिः पृषत्कैः शिलाशितैर्बहिणबर्हवाजितैः। विव्याध कर्णः पुरुषप्रवीरो धनंजय तिर्यगवेक्षमाणः॥
en: In that very moment, Karna, looking askance on Dananjaya, struck that foremost of men with ten arrows whetted on stone and adorned with peacock feathers.

sa: तपसस्तस्य चान्तेऽथ प्रीतिमानभवद् विभुः। वरेण च्छन्दयामास ततश्चैनं पितामहः॥
