en: When his penances were terminated the powerful Brahman became pleased with him. The Grandfather, therefore, desired to grant him boons.

sa: काले मृदुर्यो भवति काले भवति दारुणः। प्रसाधयति कृत्यानि शत्रु चाप्यधितिष्ठति॥
en: That king who becomes mild when mildness is necessary and who becomes stern when sternness is necessary, gains all his ends, and represses his enemies.

sa: प्रातिपेयं महेष्वासं हतं भल्लेन बाह्निकम्। प्रसुप्तमिव शार्दूलं पश्य कृष्ण मनस्विनम्॥
en: See, Pratipa's son Valhika, that powerful and highly energetic bowman, slain with a broad-headed shaft, is now lying on the ground like a sleeping tiger.

sa: कृतजप्याह्निकः श्रीमानाश्रमं च जगाम ह॥ कलशं जलपूर्णं वै गृहीत्वा जनमेजया
en: Having finished his ablutions and silent prayers, the blessed Devala returned to his hermitage, O Janamejaya, taking with him his carthen pitcher filled with water.

sa: महाधनं शिल्पिवरैः प्रयत्नतः कृतं यदस्योत्तमवर्म भास्वरम्। सुदीर्घकालेन ततोऽस्य पाण्डवः क्षणेन बाणैर्बहुधा व्यशातयत्॥
en: Pandu's son cut-off in no time into pieces the costly and shinning arınour of Karna that had been prepared with great care by clever artists working for a long time.

sa: ततोऽभवत्तमो घोरं सैन्येन रजसा वृते। तानपाक्रमतोऽद्राक्षं तस्माद् देशादरिंदम॥
en: When that darkness covered everything, O king, we saw those brave heroes, horses and men move away from that spot.

sa: चातुर्विद्ये च ये प्रोक्ताश्चातुर्होत्रे च भारत॥ योगे सांख्ये च नियता ये च धर्माः सनातनाः। चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य यश्चोक्तो धर्मो न स्म विरुध्यते॥ सेव्यमानः सवैयाख्यो गाङ्गेय विदितस्तव।
en: Everything again that is in the four branches of learning, in the four Hotras, O Bharata, as also those eternal duties that are laid down in Yoga and Sankhya philosophy, the duties too of the four orders and those duties that are not inconsistent with their practices, all these, along with their interpretations,-O son of Ganga, are known to you.

sa: नासम्यक्कृतकारी स्यादप्रमत्तः सदा भवेत्। कण्टकोऽपि हि दुश्छिन्नो विकारं कुरुते चिरम्॥
en: Every work should be done completely. One should be always careful. If extracted badly, such a minute thing as a thorn leads to obstinate gangrene.

sa: तत्रोष्यैकां त रजनी यतिभिर्ब्राह्मणैः सह। मित्रावरुणयोः पुण्यं जगामाश्रममच्युतः॥
en: Passing one night there with the ascetics and the Brahmanas, Rama then went to the sacred hermitage of the Mitravarunas.

sa: अश्वत्थामोवाच सहैव भवता ब्रह्मन् स्थास्यामि पुरुषेष्विह। सत्यवागस्तु भगवानयं च पुरुषोत्तमः॥
en: Ashvatthaman said was With yourself among all men, O Rishi, I shall reside. Let the words of this illustrious and foremost of men prove true.'

sa: एक एकेन संगम्य यत् ते सम्मतमायुधम्॥
en: Fight any one of us taking whatever weapon you like. All of us will fight.

sa: ययुश्च शिविरं तेषां सम्प्रसुप्तजनं विभो। द्वारदेशं तु सम्प्राप्य द्रौणिस्तस्थौ महारथः॥
en: They proceeded, O lord, towards the encampment of the Panchalas within which everybody was asleep. Having approached the gate, Drona's son, that great car-warriors, stopped."

sa: इति ते सर्वमाख्यातं यो दण्डो मनुजर्षभ। नियन्ता सर्वलोकस्य धर्माकान्तस्य भारत॥
en: I have now, O foremost of men, told you everything as to who punishment is, that restrainer of the universe which is governed by righteousness.

sa: प्रत्युपस्थितकालस्य सुखस्य परिवर्जनम्। अनागतसुखाशा च नैव बुद्धिमतां नयः॥
en: The relinquishing of present happiness and the pursuit of the future one, is never the policy of an intelligent person.

sa: एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं तदाचक्ष्व द्विजोत्तम। न हि तृप्यामि पूर्वेषां शृण्वानश्चरितं महत्॥
en: Describe it, О foremost of the twice-born. I wish to hear it. I am never satiated with hearing of the great feats of my forefathers.

sa: एष दुःशासनः शेते शूरेणामित्रघातिना। पीतशोणितसर्वाङ्गो युधि भीमेन पातितः॥
en: There, Dusshasana sleep, killed by Bhima, having the blood of all his limbs drunk by that heroic slayer of foes.

sa: प्राद्रवन् कुञ्जरास्ते तु भीमेसेनगदाहताः। पेतुरार्तस्वरं कृत्वा छिन्नपक्षा इवाद्रयः॥
en: Struck with Bhima's mace, those elephants, running off from him, dropped down crying like mountains with their wings cut off.

sa: संजय उवाच एतत् स नरशार्दूलो नामृष्यत तवात्मजः। सलिलान्तर्गतः श्वभ्रे महानाग इव श्वसन्॥
en: Sanjaya continued That foremost of men, your son, could not brook those words of Yudhishthira. He sighed heavily from within the water like a huge snake from with its hole.

sa: श्रुत्वा वीरविहीनानामपुत्राणां च योषिताम्। परिदेवपमानानां शान्तिं नोपलभे मुने।॥
en: Hearing the lamentations of these women who have lost their heroic husbands and children, I cannot enjoy peace, O sage.

sa: ते समन्तान्महाराज परिवार्य युधिष्ठिरम्। अदृश्य सायकैश्चक्रुर्मेघा इव दिवाकरम्॥
en: Encircling Yudhishthira on all sides they made him invisible with their arrows like clouds hiding the sun from the view.

sa: गान्धार्युवाच पश्य माधव पुत्रान्मे शतसंख्याञ्जितक्कमान्। गदया भीमसेनेन भूयिष्ठं निहतान् रणे॥
en: Gandhari said See, O Madhava, my hundred sons. who never knew fatigue in battle, have all been killed by Bhimasena with his mace in battle.

sa: दयिताश्च नरास्ते स्युभक्तिमन्तो द्विजेषु ये। न कोशः परमोऽन्योऽस्ति राज्ञां पुरुषसंचयात्॥
en: Those persons who revere the Brahmanas should be favoured by you. There is no wealth more valuable to kings than the proper selection of servants.

sa: यदि सत्यगमाः सन्ति यदि वै श्रुतयस्तथा। ध्रुवं लोकानवाप्तोऽयं नृपो बाहुबलार्जितान्॥
en: If the scriptures and the Shrutis be true, forsooth, this king has obtained the blessed region that one may acquire by the use of weapons.'

sa: स किं शोचसि मूढः सञ्शोच्यान् किमनुशोचसि। पश्य दुःखेषु दुःखानि भयेषु च भयान्यपि॥
en: Why do you, like a foolish man, grieve? Why do you grieve for them who are subject to grief? Mark, grief is enhanced by indulgence as fear is by fearing.

sa: दण्डनीतिं परित्यज्य यदा कात्स्येन भूमिपः। प्रजाः क्लिश्नात्ययोगेन प्रवर्तेत तदा कलिः॥
en: When the king, leaving aside the great science altogether, oppresses his subjects by all manner and means the age that sets in is called Kali.

sa: क्षत्रधर्मं भृशं क्रूरं निरपेक्षं सुनिघृणम्। अन्यथा तु कथं हन्युरभिमन्यु तथागतम्॥
en: This duties of a Kshatriya are high, cruel, shorn of all considerations and feelings of pity. Otherwise, how could you kill Abhimanyu under those circumstances.

sa: ततः प्रहर्षाद् बीभत्सुर्व्याक्षिपद् गाण्डिवं धनुः॥ मानयित्वा मुहुर्तं तु गुरुपुत्रं महाहवे।
en: Having shown for a short while some respect for the preceptor's son in that great battle, Vibhatsu then, smiling, drew his bow Gandiva with force.

sa: अभिवाद्य तु गोविन्दः सात्यकिस्ते च पार्थिवाः। व्यासादीनृषिमुख्यांश्च गाङ्गेयमुपतस्थिरे॥
en: Saluting those foremost of Rishis headed by Vyasa, Govinda and Satyaki and the others came to the son of Ganga.

sa: विदुरं ह्यवमत्यैषं पितरं चैन मन्दभाक्। बालो वृद्धावमानेन मन्दो मृत्युवंश गतः॥
en: Having disobeyed Vidura, and his own father, this reckless, foolish, and wicked prince has met with death, on account of his disregard of the old.

sa: ते च सम्पीडयामासुरिन्द्रियाणीव बालिशम्॥ स च तान् प्रति संरब्धः प्रत्ययोधयदाहवे।
en: The five sons of Draupadi assailed Kripa like the senses afflicting a foolish man. He, on the other hand, fighting with thein, opposed them vigorously.

sa: वणिजो नापि भिन्नायामगाधे विल्पवे यथा। अपारे पारमिच्छन्तो हते द्वीपे किरिटिना॥
en: On their main stay being destroyed by Arjuna they were like merchants, whose vessels had been wrecked on the deep main, desirous of crossing it.

sa: परिष्वज्य तदा रामः पाण्डवान् सहसृञ्जयान्। अपृच्छत् कुशलं पार्थिवांश्चामितौजसः॥ तथैव ते समासाद्य पप्रच्छुस्तमनामयम्।
en: The highly energetic Rama, having embraced the Pandavas and the Srinjayas, enquired after the welfare of all the other kings. Likewise all of them, approaching him, enquired after his welfare.

sa: हतो द्रोणश्च कर्णश्च तथा शल्यः प्रतापवान्। वैराग्नेरादिकर्तासौ शकुनिः सौबलो हतः॥
en: Drona also has been killed, and Karna, and Shalya of great prowess! Subala's son Shakuni too, that root of all this evil has been killed!

sa: ऋषय ऊचुः इदं श्रेयः परमिति वयमेवाभ्युपास्महे। शकुने ब्रूहि यच्छेरूयो भृशं ते श्रद्धामहे॥
en: The Rishis said We consider this course of life to be highly : blessed! Tell us, O bird, what is for our wellbeing! Your words fill us with great faith!

sa: नातिक्रमेच मां पार्थो धनुष्पाणिमवस्थितम्। जघने सर्वसैन्यानां शनैरश्वान् प्रचोदय॥
en: "Partha will not be able to go beyond me standing bow in hand. Drive my horses behind all the troops.

sa: यो राष्ट्रमनुगृह्णाति परिरक्षन् स्वयं नृपः॥ संजातमुपजीवन् स लभते सुमहत् फलम्।
en: That king who protects his kingdom himself and shows leniency to his subjects and supports himself upon what is easily got, succeeds in doing much.

sa: तौ मुहूर्तं समाश्वस्य पुनरेव परंतप। अभ्यहारयतां क्रुद्धो प्रगृह्य महती गदे॥
en: Having rested for a while, those two destroyers of foes, filled with rage and uplifting their maces, once more began to fight with each other.

sa: अल्पकालस्य राज्यस्य कृते मूढेन घातितः। आचार्यश्च महेष्वासः सर्वपार्थिवपूजितः॥
en: I gave a false statement of his son to our preceptor, the great bowman Drona, worshipped of all the kings.

sa: सुतः। कुञ्जरं चान्तरं कृत्वा मिथ्योपचरितं मया। सुभृशं राज्यलुब्धेन पापेन गुरुघातिना॥ सत्यकञ्चकमुन्मुच्य मया स गुरुराहवे। अश्वत्थामा हत इति निरुक्तः कुञ्जरे हते॥
en: Sinful that I am, highly covetous of kingdom, and a destroyer of my reverend elders, I behaved even thus towards my preceptor in battle, casting off the garb of truth-for I said to him that Ashvatthama had been slain when, in sooth, an elephant of the name had been slain.

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच ततो देवयुगेऽतीते देवा वै समकल्पयन्। यज्ञं वेदप्रमाणेन विधिवद् यष्टुमीप्सवः॥
en: The holy one said "After the Satya Yuga had passed away, the gods, desirous of celebrating a sacrifice, made preparations according to the Vedic prescription.

sa: श्रान्तानां चाप्यनाथानां नासीत् काचन चेतना। पाञ्चालकुरुयोषाणां कृपणं तदभून्महत्॥
en: Others became so stupefied that they lost their consciousness. Indeed, the Panchala and the Kuru ladies plunged into indescribable distress.

sa: न भोक्ष्ये न च पानीयमुपभोक्ष्ये कथञ्चन॥ शोषयिष्ये प्रियान् प्राणनिहस्थोऽहं तपोधनाः।
en: I shall abstain from taking all food and drink, and without moving from here, O great ascetic, shall dry up my life-breaths which are sodear.

sa: एते क्षत्रियदायादास्तत्र तत्र परिश्रुताः॥ धोकारहेमकारादिजातिं नित्यं समाश्रिताः। यदि मामभिरक्षन्ति ततः स्थास्यामि निश्चला॥
en: These children of the Kshatriyas have been heard of as housing in different places. They are residing with artisans and goldsmiths. If they protect me I shall then remain unmoved.

sa: क्रुद्धे चास्मिन् हसन्त्येव न च हृष्यन्ति पूजिताः। संघर्षशीलाश्च तदा भवन्त्यन्योन्यकारणात्॥
en: If the king becomes angry, they laugh; nor are they pleased if favours be conferred upon them, though they may express joy for other reasons.

sa: व्याघ्रं दृष्ट्वा क्षुधाभुग्नं दंष्ट्रिणं वनगोचरम्। द्वीपी जीवितरक्षार्थमृषिं शरणमेयिवान्॥
en: Seeing the hungry tiger of dreadful teeth approach that forest, the leopard sought the Rishi's protection for saving his life.

sa: सर्वो हि पुरुषो भोज साध्वेतदिति निश्चितः। कर्तुमारभते प्रीतो मारणादिषु कर्मसु॥
en: All persons, O chief of the Bhojas, gladly undertake enterprises that lead to death, in the belief that those enterprises will be accomplished by them.

sa: उदासीनारिमित्राणां सर्वमेव चिकीर्षितम्। पुरे जनपदे चैव ज्ञातव्यं चारचक्षुषा॥
en: Having spies for his eyes, the king should learn all the acts and intentions of his foes, friends, and neutrals.

sa: केशपक्षपरामर्श द्रौपद्या द्यूतकारिते। क्रोधाद् यदब्रवं चाहं तच्च मे हृदि वर्तते॥
en: When after the gambling match the hairs of Draupadi were seized, I gave vent to certain words in anger. I do still remember those words.

sa: पुत्रं हि मातापितरौ त्यजतः पतितं प्रियम्॥ लोको रक्षति चात्मानं पश्य स्वार्थस्य सारताम्।
en: Father and mother may be seen to discard the dear son if he is addicted to irregular practices. People take care of their own selves. See the efficacy of self-interest.

sa: वैचित्रवीर्यवचनात् कृपाशीलो युधिष्ठिरः। विनियुञ्जीत राज्ये त्वां गोविन्दवचनेन त॥
en: Yudhishthira is merciful. At the request of Vichitravirya's son and of Govinda, he will allow you to be the king.

sa: ततः स विशिरा राजन् पूतात्मा वीतकल्मषः। आजगामाश्रमं प्रीतः कृतकृत्यो महोदरः॥
en: Then, O king, freed from the Rakshasa's head Mahodara gladly returned, with purified soul and all his sins cleansed, to his hermitage after attaining success.

sa: विलापो भग्नसक्थस्य यो मे राज्ञः परिश्रुतः। वार्तिकाणां कथयतां स मे मर्माणि कृन्तति॥
en: The lamentations of the king, lying prostrate on the Earth with his thighs broken, that I have heard from the messengers circulating the news, are cutting me to the quick.

sa: क्वासे क्व च गमिष्यामि को न्वहं किमिहास्थितः। कस्मात् किमनुशोचेयमित्येवं स्थापयेन्मनः॥
en: Where am I? Where shall I go?-Who am I?—How came I here?-Why and for whom should I grieve?-Thinking of all these questions one gets tranquillity.

sa: ते च ते सफला जाता हते दुर्योधनेऽच्युत। तत्सर्वं न यथा नश्येत् क्रोधं बुद्ध्यस्व माधव॥
en: On account of Duryodhana's death, all this has not been fruitless, O you of unfading glory. O Krishna, our heart, however, is yet trembling in doubt. Know, O Madhava, that Gandhari's wrath, has been excited.

sa: सा तन्मनसि कृत्वैव महर्षेर्वचनं शुभा। अपचद् बदराण्येव न चापच्यन्त भारत॥
en: The auspicious damsel, recollecting those words of the great Rishi, began to cook those jujubes although the latter, O king, showed no signs of softening.

sa: पादाता निहता भूमौ शिश्यिरे रुधिरोक्षिताः॥ सम्भग्ना इव वातेन कर्णिकाराः सुपुष्पिताः।
en: The foot-soldiers, of your party thus slain, lay down on the ground, bathed in blood, like Karnikaras with their flowers struck down by a storm.

sa: तस्मिन् क्रुद्धेऽभवत् सर्वमसुस्थं भुवनं प्रभो। प्रसन्ने च पुनः सुस्थं प्रसन्नोऽस्य च वीर्यवान्॥
en: O monarch, when Mahadeva had become angry, the whole world was thus agitated, and, when he became gratified, Everything was safe. Highly powerful, the god Mahadeva was pleased with Ashvatthaman.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। यथा दस्युः समर्यादः प्रेत्यभावे न नश्यति॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited the old story of a robber who having in this world observed restraints was not ruined in the next.

sa: ततस्ते निहताः सर्वे तव पुत्रा महारथाः। अन्ये च बहवः शूराः पाञ्चालस्य पदानुगाः॥
en: Therefore your sons, those great carwarriors, could be killed by that warrior. And therefore also many other heroes, viz., the Panchala's, with all their followers, could be killed by him.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इदं वचः शान्तनवस्य शुश्रुवान् युधिष्ठिरः पाण्डवमुख्यसंवृतः। तदा ववन्दे च पितामहं नृपो यथोक्तमेतच्च चकार बुद्धिमान्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing these words of Shantanu's son, king Yudhishthira, always obedient in receiving instructions, endued with great intelligence, and protected by Bhima and others, then adored his grandfather and from that time began to rule according to his dictates.

sa: एवमेष क्षयो वृत्तः सुमहाँल्लोमहर्षणः। तव दुर्मन्त्रिते राजन् किमर्थमनुशोचसि॥
en: Thus took place the dreadful, hair-stirring onslaught on account of your vile policy. Whey do you grieve for it now.

sa: प्रत्यगृह्णाच तं विद्वान् सूतो गावल्गणिस्तदा। मैवमित्यब्रवीच्चैनं शमयन् सान्त्वयन्निव॥
en: His learned charioteer, Sanjaya the son of Gavalgana raised the king and soothing and comforting him, said'Do not act so.'

sa: ततः शूर्पारकं देशं सागरस्तस्य निर्ममे॥ सहसा जामदग्न्यस्य सोऽपरान्तमहीतलम्।
en: At these words, Ocean all on a sudden made for Jamadagni's son, on his other shore, a region called Surparaka.

sa: ते समासाद्य सरितं पुण्यामोघवतीं नृप। न्यवसन्नथ तां रात्रि पाण्डवा हतशत्रवः॥
en: Arrived on the banks of the sacred stream Oghavati, O king, the Pandavas, who had no enemies took up their quarters there for that night.

sa: अप्यनेकशता सेनामेक एव जिगाय सः। स वृद्धावन्धवधिरौ महारण्येऽभ्यपूजयत्॥
en: Alone, he could defeat many hundreds of soldiers. He adored daily his old, blind, and deaf parents in the forest.

sa: द्विसाहस्राश्च मातङ्गा गिरिरूपाः प्रहारिणः। सम्प्राद्रवन् हते शल्ये अङ्कुशाङ्गुष्ठनोदिताः॥
en: Two thousand elephants, looking like hills and capable of smiting, fled away, after Shalya's fall, goaded with hooks and toes.

sa: सम्भज्यमाने सैन्ये तु कुरुराजो विशाम्पते॥ परानभिमुखांश्चैव सुतस्ते समुपाद्रवत्।
en: When his army was thus routed your son, the Kuru king, rushed against his enemies who were proceeding against him.

sa: हिमवान् वा महाशैलः समुद्रो वा महोदधिः। महत्त्वान्नान्वपद्येतां नभसो वान्तरं तथा॥
en: The king of mountains, viz., Himavat, and that vast receptacle of waters, viz., the ocean, cannot, for its vastness, equal the extent of the sky.

sa: तस्यैवं वर्तमानस्य पुरुषस्य विजानतः। अमित्राः सम्प्रसीदन्ति तथा मित्रीभवन्त्यपि॥
en: A wiseman who conduct himself thus, succeeds in freeing his very enemies of their hostility and converting them into friends.

sa: त एनमभिगर्जन्तः सहिताः समुपद्रवन्॥ नानाशस्त्रभृतः क्रुद्धा भर्त्ययन्तो मुहुर्मुहुः।
en: Thereat all the Pandava warriors rushed in a body upon Duryodhana, hurled various weapons and chastised him again and again.

sa: आत्मनोऽर्थे त्वया लोको यत्नतः सर्व आहृतः। स ते संशायितस्तात आत्मा वै भरतर्षभ॥
en: For Accomplishing your own object you had, with great care, mustered together a large force. That huge force as also yourself, O best of Bharatas, have fallen into great danger.

sa: ताः समासाद्य राजानं भृशं शोकसमन्विताः। आमन्त्र्यान्योन्यमीयुः स्म भृशमुच्चुक्रुशुस्ततः॥
en: Stricken with great grief, they came together to the king. As they met, they addressed each other and cried aloud.

sa: ततः श्रुतर्वा संक्रुद्धो धनुरादाय सायकैः। भीमसेन रणे राजन् बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्॥
en: Then excited with rage, Shrutarvan took up his bow and struck Bhimasena in that battle, O king, with many arrows on his arms and chest.

sa: दशवर्षसहस्राणि दशवर्षशतानि च। अयोध्याधिपतिर्भूत्वा रामो राज्यमकारयत्॥
en: Seated on the throne of Ayodhya, he ruled for ten thousand and ten hundred years.

sa: तथैव पृथिवीं लब्ध्वा ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगाः। संश्रिता दानवानां वै साह्यार्थं दर्पमोहिताः॥
en: Having occupied the Earth, a host of Brahmanas, conversant with the Vedas, armed themselves, stupefied with pride, with the Danavas for helping in the fight.

sa: ततोऽर्जुनस्य बाहूंस्तांश्छित्त्वा रामो रुषान्वितः। तं भ्रमन्तं ततो वत्सं जामदग्न्यः स्वमाश्रमम्॥ प्रत्यानयत राजेन्द्र तेषामन्तःपुरात् प्रभुः।
en: The powerful Rama, the son of Jamadagni, filled with anger cut off the arms of Arjuna and brought back, O king, his father's calf which was grazing within the inner appointment of the king's mansion.

sa: अथ राष्ट्रमुपायेन भुज्यमानं सुरक्षितम्। जनयत्यतुलां नित्यं कोशवृद्धिं युधिष्ठिर॥
en: By protecting a kingdom properly and ruling it judiciously a king, O Yudhishthira, may succeed in always acquiring immense wealth.

sa: न हि श्रोतास्मि भीष्मस्य धर्मयुक्तं प्रभाषितम्॥ दुर्योधनस्य च तथा वृषभस्येव नर्दतः। श्रुत्वा कर्णस्य च विपर्ययम्॥ द्रोणसूर्योपरागं च हृदयं मे विदीर्यते।
en: I did not listen to the good counsels of Bhishma. Alas, having heard of the destruction of Duryodhana whose roars were as deep as those of a bull, of the death of Dusshasana and the extinction of Karna and the setting of the Drona-sun, my-heart is not sundered into pieces.

sa: परिणामश्च वयसः सर्वबन्धुक्षयश्च मे॥ सुहृन्मित्रविनाशश्च दैवयोगादुपागतः। कोऽन्योऽस्ति दुःखिततरो मत्तोऽन्यो हि पुमान् भुवि॥
en: This destruction of all my relatives, wellwishers and friends, at this old age has been brought about by Destiny. Who is there on Earth more afflicted than my wretched self.

sa: ततो मुहूर्तादिव तद् गजानीकमविध्यत॥ गदया भीमसेनेन नाराचैरर्जुनेन च।
en: Then within a short time that elephant force was killed by Bhimasena with his mace and Arjuna with his arrows.

sa: एवमुक्तवा महात्मानं भगवानात्मनस्तनुम्। आविवेश ददौ चास्मै विमलं खड्गमुत्तमम्॥
en: Having said top the great Ashvatthaman, the divine Mahadeva entered Ashvatthaman's body after giving him an excellent and polished sword.

sa: कृप उवाच दिष्ट्या ते प्रतिकर्तव्य मतिर्जातेयमच्युत। न त्वं वारयितुं शक्तो वज्रपाणिरपि स्वयम्॥
en: Kripa Said “By good luck, O you of great glory, your heart is bent to-day on vengeance! The holder of the thunder himself will not succeed in dissuading you to-day.

sa: आवाभ्यां सहितः शत्रूश्वो निहन्ता समागमे। विक्रम्य रथिनां श्रेष्ठ पञ्चालान् सपदानुगान्॥
en: United with ourselves, you will kill the enemy, viz., the Panchalas will all their followers, tomorrow in battle, displaying your prowess, O best of car-warriors.

sa: शक्तस्त्वमसि विक्रम्य विश्रमस्व निशामिमाम्। चिरं ते जाग्रत स्तात स्वप तावन्निशामिमाम्॥
en: If you display your energy your quite competent to achieve that feat! Take rest, therefore, for this night. You have kept us many a night.

sa: विश्रान्तश्च विनिद्रश्च स्वस्थचित्तश्च मानद। समेत्य समरे शत्रून् वधिष्यसि न संशयः॥
en: Having rested and slept, and having become quite refreshed, O giver of honours, meet the cnemy in battle! Forsooth, you will kill then the enemy.

sa: व्यक्षरस्तु भवेन्मृत्युस्त्र्यक्षरं ब्रह्म शाश्वतम्। ममेति च भवेन्मृत्युर्न ममेति च शाश्वतम्॥
en: The word mama (mine), consisting of two letters, is veritable Death; while the opposite word na-mama (not mine) consisting of three letters, is eternal Brahma.

sa: मद्रेश्वरः क्षुरप्रेण तदा मारिष चिच्छेिदे। तदशीर्यत विच्छिन्नं धनुः शल्यस्य सायकैः॥
en: Then the king of the Madras, O sire, cut off, with a razor-headed arrow, the bow with arrow fixed on it of the great Nakula.

sa: व्यास उवाच मा विषादं कृथा राजन् क्षत्रधर्ममनुस्मरन्। स्वधर्मेण हता ह्येते क्षत्रियाः क्षत्रियर्षभ॥
en: Vyasa said, Remembering the duties of a Kshatriya, O king, do not indulge in grief! All those Kshatriyas, O foremost of Kshatriyas, have been killed while following their legitimate duties.

sa: युष्माभिस्तानि चीर्णानि यान्यसाधूनि साधुषु। अकारणकृतान्येव तेषां वः फलमागतम्॥
en: You have done many misdeeds without any cause, by the righteous Pandavas. The fruits of those acts have now come.

sa: संचये च विनाशान्ते मरणान्ते च जीवित। संयोगे च वियोगान्ते को नु विप्रणयेन्मनः॥
en: Who is there that would busy himself with boarding when destruction is its end, hanker after life when death is its end, and after union when separation is its end?

sa: दुःखं नूनं कुरुश्रेष्ठ चरिष्याम महीमिमाम्॥ हीनानां नस्त्वया राजन् कुतः शान्तिः कुतः सुखम्।
en: Forsooth, O Kuru king, we shall have to rove in sorrow on the Earth! Deprived of you, O king, where can we enjoy peace and where can we have happiness.

sa: दुर्योधनस्तु द्विरदमारुद्याचलसंनिभम्। छत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन वीज्यमानश्च चामरैः॥ ते न गन्तव्यं न गन्तव्यमिति मद्रानवारयत्।
en: Duryodhana, riding upon a huge mountainlike elephant with an umbrella held over his head and fanned with white chowries, forbade the Madraka warriors, saying "Do not proceed, Do not proceed!”

sa: वैश्मपायन उवाच शृणुष्वैतदुपाख्यानं यथावृत्तं जनेश्वर॥ यथा बिभेद समयं नमुचेर्वासवः पुरा।
en: Vaishampayana said "Listen to that history, O king, listen to those events as they took place. Hear how Indra formerly broke his treaty with Namuchi.

sa: कृतवैरे न विश्वासः कार्यस्विह सुहृद्यपि। छन्नं संतिष्ठते वैरं गूढोऽग्निरिव दारुषु।:४४॥
en: When enmity has arisen with even a friend, no further trust should be placed in him. Feelings of enmity lie hidden like fire in forest.

sa: सैनापत्यं लब्धवान् देवतानां महासेनो यत्र दैत्यान्तकर्ता। साक्षाचैव न्यवसत् कार्तिकेयः सदा कुमारो यत्र स प्लक्षराजः॥
en: There, on the occasion, Mahasena, that destroyer of Daityas, became the generalissimo of the celestial forces. In that tirtha is a huge Ashvattha tree. Under its shade, Kartikeya, otherwise called Kumara, always lives in person."

sa: स्वयं चैवावरोह त्वमेतच्छ्रेयस्तवानघ। तचाकरोत् तथा वीरः पाण्डुपुत्रो धनंजयः॥
en: Get down, for this is for your own good, O sinless one!'-Pandu's brave son, Dhananjaya, did as he was directed.

sa: मान्धातोवाच बृहस्पतेर्मतं राजन्नधीतं सकलं त्वया। तथैवोशनसं शास्त्रं विज्ञातं ते नरोत्तम॥
en: Mandhatri said You have, O king, studied all the doctrines of Brihaspati! O best of men, you know also the doctrines laid down by Ushanas.

sa: सोऽतिविद्धो महाराज तव पुत्रेण धन्विना। भीमः संचुक्षुभे क्रुद्धः पर्वणीव महोदधिः॥
en: Deeply cut, О king by your son armed with the bow, Bhima grew exceedingly agitated like the ocean at the full or the new moon.

sa: विरजास्तु महाभागः प्रभुत्वं भुवि नैच्छत। न्यासायैवाभवद् बुद्धिः प्रणीता तस्य पाण्डव॥
en: The highly blessed Virajas, however, did not desire to rule on Earth. His mind, O son of Pandu, was bent for a life of renunciation.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच विदुरस्य तु तद् वाक्यं निशम्य कुरुसत्तमः। पुत्रशोकाभिसंतप्तः पपात भुवि मूर्छितः॥
en: Vaishampayana said “After hearting the words of Vidura, the chief of the Kurus, stricken with grief on account of the death of his sons, dropped down senseless on the Earth.

sa: स पूजितोऽसुरेन्द्रेण मुनिनोशनसा तथा। निषसादासने राजन् महार्हे मुनिपुङ्गवः॥
en: Adored of the king of Asuras and the sage Ushanas, that foremost of sages sat down on a rich seat.

sa: तदाप्रभृति राजेन्द्र ऋषिभिः संशितव्रतैः। मुजपृष्ठ इति प्रोक्तः स देशो रुद्रसेवितः॥
en: From that time, O king, the spot, which is a favourite resort of Rudra, passed by the naine of Munjaprishtha among Rishis of rigid vows.

sa: एकसार्थप्रयातानां सर्वेषां तत्र गामिनाम्। यस्य कालः प्रयात्यग्रे तत्र का परिदेवना॥
en: All creatures are like members of a caravan bound for the same country. When death will overtake all, it is immaterial whom he meets first.

sa: तामृचीकस्तदा दृष्ट्वा तस्या गर्भगतं द्विजम्। अब्रवीद् भृगुशार्दूलः स्वां भार्यां देवरूपिणीम्॥
en: Seeing the Brahmana child lying within her womb, that foremost of the Bhrigus said to his wife of heavenly beauty these wordsमात्रासि व्यंसिता भद्रे चरुव्यत्यासहेतुना।

sa: अकृष्टपच्या पृथिवी पुटके पुटके मधु। सर्वा द्रोणदुधा गावो वैन्यस्यासन् प्रशासतः॥
en: The Earth, during his regime produced crops without being tilled, every leaf of the trees bore honey, and every cow gave a jugful of milk.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु दाशार्हः पाण्डवेन यशस्विना॥ अचोदयद्धयान् राजन् दुर्योधनबलं प्रति।
en: Thus accosted by Pandu's son of great mental strength, the Dasarha heroe urged his horses, O king, towards Duryodhana's detachment.

sa: संजय उवाच पश्यतां यतमानानां शूराणामनिवर्तिनाम्। संकल्पमकरोन्मोघं गाण्डीवेन धनंजयः॥
en: Sanjaya said With his Gandiva, Dhananjaya baffled the purpose of those unretreating heroes struggling in battle and striking their enemies.

sa: विधिप्रयुक्तान् नरदेवधर्मा नुक्तान् समासेन निबोध बुद्ध्या। इमान् विदध्याद् व्यतिसृत्य यो वै राजा महीं पालयितुं स शक्तः॥
en: O king, I have briefly described to you of all the duties laid down in the scriptures. Attend to them, helped by your intelligence. That king, who, in obeying his protector, attends to these, succeeds in ruling the whole Earth.

sa: भीष्मस्तु पुरुषव्याघ्रः कर्मणा मनसा गिरा॥ शरतल्पगतः कृष्णं प्रदध्यौ प्राञ्जलिः शुचिः।
en: Lying on his bed of arrows, that foremost of men, Bhishma, with pure hearts and joined hands, thought of Krishna in mind, word, and deed.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महातेजाः : पुत्रान् परमधार्मिकान्। व्यादिदेश महाप्राज्ञान् यज्ञसम्भारकारणात्॥
en: Having said this, that exceedingly energetic one ordered his highly virtuous and profoundly wise sons to provide the sacrificial necessaries.

sa: मम सना मतिः सीते नेतुं त्वां दण्डकावनम्। वसिष्यामीति सा त्वं मामनुयातुं सुनिश्चिता॥
en: My resolution of not taking you, O Sītā, to the forest of Dandaka is now rent asunder, as you have prepared yourself to live in the forest and follow me.

sa: स त्वं केसरिणः पुत्रः क्षेत्रजो भीमविक्रमः॥ मारुतस्यौरसः पुत्रस्तेजसा चापि तत्समः।
en: You, endowed with drawful vigour, are the son of Kesarī by his wife; and, resemble the Wind in energy, you had sprung from his loins.

sa: समभूमितले रम्ये दुमैर्बहुभिरावृते। पुण्ये रंस्यामहे तात चित्रकूटस्य कानने॥
en: O child, we will disport in the sacred woods of Citrakuta with fine level plains, and covered with divers trees.

sa: अवतीर्य रथात् तस्मात् ततः काञ्चनभूषणात्॥ हस्ते गृहीत्वा मारीचं रावणो वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।
en: And descending now from the golden car the lord of Rākşasas together with Mārīca beheld Răma's asylum. Taking him (Mārīca) by the hand Ravana spoke.

sa: कैलासशिखरेभ्यश्च सिंहकेसरवर्चसाम्। ततः कोटिसहस्राणि वानराणां समागमन्॥
en: And a thousand kotis, hued like the lion's mane, came from the peaks of Kailāsa.

sa: इक्ष्वाकूणां कुले जातः साक्षाद् धर्म इवापरः। धृतिमान् सुव्रतः श्रीमान् न धर्म हातुमर्हसि॥
en: Born in the line of Ikşvāku, you are the very second self of virtue. And endowed with patience, and auspicious, and observing excellent vows, you ought not to renounce virtue.

sa: अनाहारः कथं शक्तो भग्नसक्थिशिरोमुखः॥ वज्रेणाभिहतः कालं सुदीर्घमपि जीवितुम्। स एवमुक्तः शक्रो मे बाहू योजनमायतौ॥ तदा चास्यं च मे कृक्षौ तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रमकल्पयत्।
en: Where to I replied 'How shall I live long without any food, being smitten by you having a thunderbolt in your hand, and having my head, thighs and mouth crushed down?' Thereat Indra made my hands extending over a Yojana and placed my mouth, having sharpened teeth, on my belly.

sa: परिभ्रमति चित्राणि मण्डलानि विनिष्पतन्। • समुद्वीक्ष्य च सर्वे तं मृगा येऽन्ये वोचराः॥
en: He then began to range at large in the beautiful forest (extending far and wide). Seeing him other forest-deer came (by hiin) and smelling him fled away into different quarters.

sa: तां दिशं दक्षिणां गत्वा शरचापासिधारिणौ। अविप्रहतमैक्ष्वाकौ पन्थानं प्रतिपेदतुः॥
en: Then turning to the south, with bow and arrows in hand, they reached a track not wended by the people.

sa: एष वै सुमहाञ्छ्रीमान् विटपी सम्प्रकाशते। विराजत्युज्ज्वलस्कन्धः कोविदारध्वजो रथे।॥
en: Yonder is seen the graceful tree. By the same apr-ars on the car the Kovidāra standard, having a shining top.

sa: धनुरादाय सगुणं खनित्रपिटकाधरः। अग्रतस्ते गमिष्यामि पन्थानं तव दर्शयन्॥
en: I shall go before you pointing out your course, with stringed bows, a hoe, and a basket in my hands.

sa: चारित्रेण च को युक्तः सर्वभूतेषु को हितः। विद्वान् कः कः समर्थश्च कश्चैकप्रियदर्शनः॥
en: Who is qualified by virtue of his character, and who is engaged in the welfare of all creatures? Who is learned and capable. Who alone is ever lovely to behold?

sa: नूपुरोत्कृष्टलीलेव खेलं गच्छति भामिनी। इदानीमपि वैदेही तद्रागान्यस्तभूषणा ॥
en: Still Vaidehī decked in ornaments from affection for Rāma, goes gracefully rebuking with her bangles the wavy gait (of cranes).

sa: जीवपुत्रे निवर्तस्व पुत्र रक्षस्व चाङ्गदम्। अन्तको रामरूपेण हत्वा नयति वालिनम्॥
en: O you, having your son alive, do you go back and bring up your son Angada. Death himself, under Rāma's semblance, has snatched away Vāli.

sa: अथ रामः सरिन्मध्यो पप्रच्छ मुनिपुङ्गवम्॥ वारिणो भिद्यमानस्य किमयं तुमुलो ध्वनिः।
en: And reaching the middle of the river, Rāma asked that best of ascetics, What is this loud uproar that seem to come riving the waters?

sa: श्रूयतां राम वक्ष्यामि सुग्रीवो नाम वानरः। भ्रात्रा निरस्तः क्रुद्धेन वालिना शक्रसूनुना॥ ऋष्यमूके गिरिवरे पम्पापर्यन्तशोभिते। निवसत्यात्मवान् वीरश्चतुर्भिः सह वानरैः॥
en: Do you hear, O Rāma, what I relate. There live with four monkeys a heroic, self-controlled monkey by name Sugrīva, on that best of mountains Rşyamūka, situated on the banks of the lake Pampā, being driven by his enraged brother Vāli, the son of Indra.

sa: इति माल्यैः सुरगणान् गन्धैश्चापि यशस्विनी। स्तुतिभिश्चानुरूपाभिरान यतलोचना॥ ज्वलनं समुपादाय ब्राह्मणेन महात्मना। हावयामास विधिना राममङ्गलकारणात्॥ घृतं श्वेतानि माल्यानि समिधश्वैव सर्षपान्। उपसम्पादयामास कौसल्या परमाङ्गना॥
en: That best of women Kausalyā, of great renown and having expansive eyes, after propitiating the celestials with garlands, fragrant odours and praises, began to offer oblations to the fire by the help of eminent Brahmins for the welfare of Rāma, collecting clarified butter, white garlands, religious fig trees and white mustard seeds for this purpose.

sa: अथ तस्याप्रमेयस्य मुनेर्वचनमुत्तमम्। श्रुत्वा पुरुषशार्दूलः प्रत्युवाच शुभां गिरम्॥
en: Hearing this excellent speech of that ascetic of immeasurable energy, that foremost of men answered him in these happy words,

sa: या गतिर्यज्ञशीलानामाहिताग्नेश्च या गतिः। अपरावर्तिनां या च या च भूमिप्रदायिनाम्॥ मया त्वं समनुज्ञातो गच्छ लोकाननुत्तमान्। गृध्रराज महासत्व संस्कृतश्च मया व्रज॥
en: Being consecrated and commanded by me, do you, O highly powerful king of birds, attain to that excellent state of existence, which is reached by persons ever performing pious observance, by Āhilāgnis by heroes who are not afraid of entering a battle-field and by persons who confer grants of land.

sa: सदृशश्चासि रामेण विक्रमेण बलेन च। सहायो दैवतैर्दत्तश्चिराय हरिपुंगव॥
en: Resembling Rāma himself in strength and prowess, you, O chief of monkeys, have been ordained his help by the gods.

sa: तच्चानीकं महावेगं रामं समनुवर्तत ॥ धृतनानाप्रहरणं गम्भीरं सागरोपमम्।
en: And that army resembling the ocean, and rife with sounds, equipped with various weapons, with furious speed came towards Rāma.

sa: दर्शयित्वा तु रामाय सीतायाः परिमार्गणे। वाक्यमन्वर्थमर्थज्ञः कबन्धः पुनरब्रवीत्॥
en: Having pointed out to Rāma the expedient for finding out Sītā the wise Kabandha began with the following significant words.

sa: तत्र हंसाः प्लवाः कौञ्चाः कुरराश्चैव राघव॥ वल्गुस्वरा निकूजन्ति पम्पासलिलगोचराः। नोद्विजन्ते नरान् दृष्ट्वा वधस्याकोविदाः पुराः॥
en: There emit forth musical notes, swans, frogs, cranes and ospreys sporting in the lake Pampā. They are not filled with terror in view of human beings, inexperienced as they are in the matter of destruction.

sa: वृद्धे पितरि स्वर्याते धर्मेण धुरमावहम्। भ्रातरं देवसंकाशं स्नेहात् पश्यन् कुशध्वजम्॥
en: And on my aged sire ascending heaven, I righteously ruled the kingdom and cherished my brother Kusadvaja resembling a celestial, with the eye of affection.

sa: यस्ते प्रभावः सुग्रीव यच्च ते शौचमीदृशम्। अर्हस्त्वं कपिराज्यस्य श्रियं भोक्तुमनुत्तमाम्॥
en: Such is your strength, O Sugriva, and such your self-denial, that you are fully worthy to enjoy the good fortune of the king of monkeys.

sa: कश्चिदाम्रवणं छित्त्वा पलाशांश्च निषिञ्चति। पुष्पं दृष्ट्वा फले गृध्नुः स शोचति फलागमे॥ अविज्ञाय फलं यो हि कर्म त्वेवानुधावति। स शोचेत् फलवेलायां यथा किंशुकसेचकः॥
en: He that cutting down a mango grove, waters Palasa trees, beholding the flowers (blooming), will covet fruits; and grieve when their season arrives. The person that without apprehending (the principle of causation) rushed to action, grieves at the season of fruits, even like him that waters kinsuka trees (hewing down his mango grove). or are

sa: त्वया विगण्य वातापे परिभूताश्च तेजसा। जीवलोके द्विज श्रेष्ठास्तस्मादसि जरां गतः॥
en: Being blinded with your prowess O Vātāpi, you have destroyed many eminent twice-born ones on this earth and for this that I do digest you.

sa: सा हि चन्दनकवर्णाभा ग्रीवा ग्रैवेयकोचिता। कोमला विलपन्त्यास्तु कान्ताया भक्षिता शुभा॥
en: Her neck had the hue of sandal and was adorned with necklace—that beautiful tender neck was eaten up by the Rākşasas, my beloved wife wailing.

sa: अस्ति कच्चित्त्वया दृष्ट्वा सा कदम्बप्रिया प्रिया। कदम्ब यदि जानीषे शंस सीतां शुभाननाम्॥ स्निग्धपल्लवसंकाशां पीतकौशेयवासिनीम्। शंसस्व यदि सा दृष्ट्वा बिल्ब बिल्वोपमस्तनी॥
en: O Kadamba, have you seen where is that one fond of Kadamba groves? If know you this do you tell me of Sītā having an auspicious countenance. O Bilva, tell me pray, if you have seen her, wearing silken cloth, resembling cool leaves and having breast like to Bilva fruits.

sa: इह राम महाबाहो विष्णुर्देवनमस्कृतः। वर्षाणि सुबहूनीह तथा युगशतानि च॥ तपश्चरणयोगार्थमुवास सुमहातपाः। एष पूर्वाश्रमो राम वामनस्य महात्मनः॥
en: Here, O mighty-armed Rama, Visnu of mighty asceticism worshipped of all the deities, for years upon years, and hundreds of Yugas, dwelt for carrying on his austerities and Yoga. This, O Rāma, was formerly the hermitage of the high-souled Vāmana.

sa: कुर्वाणा बहुशब्दांश्च प्रकृष्टा बाहुशालिनः। शिरोभिर्वानरेन्द्राय सुग्रीवाय न्यवेदयन् ॥
en: And, crying in various tones, prime monkeys furnished with arms, with bent heads spoke humbly to that lord of monkeys—Sugrīva.

sa: तं गृधं प्रेक्ष्य ताम्राक्षं गतासुमचलोपमम्। रामः सुबहुभिर्दुःखैर्दीनः सौमित्रिमब्रवीत्॥
en: Beholding the vulture dead, of huge proportions, resembling a hill and having red eyes, Rama, aggrieved, spoke piteously to Saumitri.

sa: भ्राता भव यवीयांस्त्वं शक्रस्यासुरसूदन। शोकार्तानां तु देवानां साहाय्यं कर्तुमर्हसि ॥
en: O adorable deity! Do you become the younger brother of Sakra, O destroyer of Asuras. It behove you to help the celestials afflicted with grief.

sa: यानि त्वौषधजालानि तस्मिञ्जातानि पर्वते। विषघ्नान्यपि नागानां न शेकुः शमितुं विषम्॥
en: Although there were many medical herbs, capable of counteracting poison, which had sprung up on that mountain, could not neutralise that poison of the snakes.

sa: विचेतनं विघूर्णन्तं शीतेषुबलपीडितम्। निरस्तं दृश्य मारीचं रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्॥
en: And finding Mārica senseless, and whirling, and afflicted by the might of the weapon, and overcome, Rama addressed Laksmana, saying.

sa: स्त्रीसहस्रनिनादश्च संजज्ञे राजवेश्मनि। हा हा रामेति सहसा भूषणध्वनिमिश्रितः।।१९
en: And there arose in the palace cries of women by thousands of "Ah Rāma,” mingled with the tinkling of ornaments.

sa: प्रणष्टा श्रीश्च कीर्तिश्च कपिराजं च शाश्वतम्। रामप्रसादात् सौमित्रे पुनश्चाप्तमिदं मया॥
en: You son to Sumitrā, by the favour of Rāma have I received back my lost luck, my fame, and this eternal monarchy of the monkeys.

sa: कस्य वा पररात्रेऽहं श्रोष्यामि हृदयङ्गमम्। अधीयानस्य मधुरं शास्त्रं वान्यद् विशेषतः॥
en: At the small hours, form whom engaged in study, shall I hear the scriptures sweetly read in a way coming home to the listener's mind?

sa: एवमुक्ताः स्त्रियः सर्वाः सुमन्त्रेण नृपाज्ञया। प्रचक्रमुस्तद् भवनं भर्तुराज्ञाय शासनम् ॥
en: Thus addressed by Sumantra at the mandate of the monarch, the ladies in a body, informed of their husband's command, went to the king's apartment.

sa: लक्ष्मणं चानुजानीहि सीता चान्वेतु मां वनम्। कारणैर्बहुभिस्तथ्यैर्वार्यमाणौ न चेच्छतः।।२३ अनुजानीहि सर्वान् नः शोकमुत्सृज्य मानद। लक्ष्मणं मां च सीतां च प्रजापतिरिवात्मजान्॥
en: Do you permit Lakşmaņa, and let Sītā also follow me to the woods; for although prohibited by me with various reasons, they do not wish to be left behind. Do you O bestower of honour, permit us all, renouncing sorrow, Lakṣmaṇa and Sītā and me, like Prajāpati permitting his sons.

sa: शुश्रूषुर्जननीं पुत्र स्वगृहे नियतो वसन्। परेण तपसा युक्तः काश्यपस्त्रिदिवं गतः॥
en: Hear, Oh my son, the great ascetic Kasyapa, lived in his house, serving his mother continually and being crowned with best moral merit reached heaven.

sa: त्वया राज्यमयोध्यायां प्राप्तव्यं लोकसत्कृतम्। वस्तव्यं दण्डकारण्ये मया वल्कलवाससा॥
en: You ought to receive the kingdom, Ayodhyā, honoured of men; and I ought to dwell in Dandaka dressed in bark.

sa: तस्यां गङ्गेयमभवज्ज्येष्ठा हिमवतः सुता। उमा नाम द्वितीयाभूत् कन्या तस्यैव राघव॥
en: She of whom was born Gangā the elder daughter of Himavat; and , O Raghava, a second daughter was also born to him, named Uma.

sa: त्रीन् पथो हेतुना केन प्लावयेल्लोकपावनी। कथं गङ्गा त्रिपथगा विश्रुता सरिदुत्तमा॥
en: Why is it that purifier of the worlds lave three directions? And why is that foremost of streams, Gangā, famous as wending in three ways

sa: कृता सुसंस्था सौमित्रे सुग्रीवेण पुरा यथा। अद्य तैर्वानरैः सर्वैरागन्तव्यं महाबलैः॥
en: Things, O Saumitri, have beforehand been so satisfactorily arranged by Sugrīva, that this very day the mighty one will be joined with all those monkeys.

sa: तांश्च प्रतीक्षमाणोऽयं विक्रान्तान् सुमहाबलान्। राघवस्यार्थसिद्ध्यर्थं न निर्याति हरीश्वरः॥
en: Expecting these powerful and exceedingly strong ones, for attaining Rāghava's end, this lord of monkeys does not (yet) sally out.

sa: परवानस्मि काकुत्स्थ त्वयि वर्षशतं स्थिते। स्वयं तु रुचिरे देशे क्रियतामिति मां वद॥
en: O Kákutstha, even if I were to stay with you for an hundred years, I shall remain your servant. Thyself selecting some beauteous spot do you tell me-'Construct (an asylum)'.

sa: अथापि किं जीवितमद्य मे वृथा त्वया विना चन्द्रिभाननाप्रभ। अनुव्रजिष्यामि वनं त्वयैव गौः सुदुर्बला वत्समिवाभिकाश्या॥
en: Oh, you, having a countenance of moon-like splendour, wretched indeed is my life without you, I shall follow you to the forest out of great affection, like to an enfeebled cow following her young one.

sa: किमत्र धनुषा कार्यमसिना वा सचर्मणा। महाबले महोत्साहे भरते स्वयमागते ॥
en: When the mighty Bharata possessed of high spirits has himself come here, what is the use of the bow or the sword or the shield?

sa: वने वा चीरवसनं सौम्य कृष्णाजिनाम्बरम्। राज्ये वापि महाराजो मां वासयितुमीश्वरः॥
en: O mild one, the monarch is competent to make me stay in the woods clad in black deerskin, as to establish me in the monarchy.

sa: उदारसत्वाभिजनो हनूमान् स मैथिली ज्ञास्यति वानरेन्द्र। दिशं तु यामेव गता तु सीता तामास्थितो वायुसुतो हनूमान् ॥
en: O lord of monkeys, possessed of great strength and nobly born, it is Hanumān who will be able to ascertain the whereabouts of Mithila's daughter. And the Wind's son, Hanumān, has followed even the has by which Sītā has gone.

sa: ते गत्वा परमं राम कैलासं धातुमण्डितम्। अग्नि नियोजयामासुः पुत्रार्थं सर्वदेवताः॥
en: Then, O Rama, repairing to the Kailasa mountain teeming with metals, the deities commissioned Agni with the view of having a son (born to him.)10

sa: रावणेन तु वैदेही तदा पृष्टा जिहीर्षुणा। परिव्राजकरूपेण शशंसात्मानमात्मना॥
en: Being thus addressed by Rāvaņa under the guise of a mendicant, desirous of carrying her away Vaidehī thought within herself.

sa: अप्यावां युगपत् प्राप्तावपश्याव महीतले। रथचक्रप्रमाणानि नगराणि पृथक् पृथक् ॥ क्वचिद् वादित्रघोषश्च क्वचिद् भूषणनिःस्वनः। गायन्ती: स्माङ्गना बह्वीः पश्यावो रक्तवाससः॥
en: And simultaneously plunging into the serial deep) we saw on the earth beneath separate cities resembling car-wheels; and here the sound of musical instruments, and there the tinklings of ornaments. And (at places) we beheld many a damsel clad in red attire, engaged in singing.

sa: ततः प्रास्थानिकं कृत्वा कार्यशेषमनन्तरम्। वसिष्ठेनाभ्यनुज्ञाता दूताः संत्वरितं ययुः॥
en: Then having supplied themselves with the necessaries of the journey, the envoys in consonance with Vasiştha's injunction, speedily went away.

sa: अरिष्टनेमेर्दुहिता सुपर्णभगिनी तु सा। द्वितीया सगरस्यासीत् पत्नी सुमतिसंज्ञिता॥
en: The second wife of Sagara was called Sumati, who was the daughter of Aristanemi and the sister of Suparna (Garuda).

sa: अभिकालं ततः प्राप्य तेजोऽभिभवनाच्च्युताः। पितृपैतामहीं पुण्यां तेरुरिक्षुमती नदीम्॥
en: And having passed Tejobhibhavana and arrived at Abhikāla, they crossed the sacred stream Ikşumatī belonging to the Ikşvākus for generations.

sa: तस्य वेगसमुघुष्टं जलं सजलदं तदा। अम्बरस्थं विबभ्राजे शरदभ्रमिराततम्।७१।।
en: The waters lashed up to the clouds by the force (of his speed), looked like autumnal clouds overspreading the sky.

sa: न जाने निलयं तस्य सर्वथा पापरक्षसः। सामर्थ्य विक्रमं वापि दौष्कुलेयस्य वा कुलम्॥
en: I do not know the hidden abode of that exceedingly wicked Raksasa,-nor do l know his heroism and prowess, or the lineage of that one sprung from a vicious race.

sa: एकः कस्याः सुतो ब्रह्मन् का बहूञ्जनयिष्यति। श्रोतुमिच्छामहे ब्रह्मन् सत्यमस्तु वचस्तव॥
en: Who of us, O Brahmana, shall produce a single son, and who many? This, O Brāhmaṇa, we wish to hear. May your word prove true!

sa: वादयन्ति तदा शान्ति लासयन्त्यपि चापरे। नाटकान्यपरे स्माहुर्हास्यानि विविधानि च॥ ।
en: Some played on instruments; some for the purpose of pacifying his mind, danced (the courtezans); others performed scenes variously fraught with the sentiment of mirth.

sa: मुनेस्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा केशिनी रघुनन्दन। पुत्रं वंशकरं राम जग्राह नृपसंनिधौ॥
en: Hearing the ascetic's words, O descendant of Raghu, Kesinī in the presence of the monarch chose, O Rāma, a single son to perpetuate the line.

sa: मामेवं हि पुरा वीर त्वमेव बहुशोक्तवान्। अनुशिष्याद्धि को नु त्वामपि साक्षाद् बृहस्पतिः॥
en: O hero, many a time and oft ere this, you had given me the self-same counsel. Who is capable of counselling you who are the very preceptor of the gods?

sa: सपर्वतवनां कृत्स्नां पृथिवीं रघुनन्दन। धारयामास शिरसा विरूपाक्षो महागजः॥
en: O son of Raghu, that mighty elephant, Virūpākşa, held on his head the entire earth with its mountains and forests.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु संहृष्टो नरसिंहो महाद्युतिः। ततः सम्मानयामास सीतामिदमुवाच ह॥
en: Being pleased with these words the mighty hero of great effulgence, honoured his father's behest and spoke to Sītā thus.

sa: ततः क्रोधसमाविष्टं संरब्धं तमुपागतम्। अहं प्रसादयांचक्रे भ्रातरं हितकाम्यया॥
en: Then wishing for my welfare I strove to propitiate my angry brother, wrought up with wrath, who was seated (there).

sa: तं तपन्तमिवादित्यमुपपन्नं स्वतेजसा। ववन्दे वरदं वन्दी विनयज्ञो विनीतवत्॥
en: Whereupon Sumantra, acquainted with decorum, humbly saluted him (Rāma), the conferrer of great boons, and resplendent like the mid-day sun.

sa: तं वैश्रवणसंकाशमुपविष्टं स्वलंकृतम्। ददर्श सूतः पर्यङ्के सौवर्णे सोत्तरच्छदे॥
en: He (on entering) saw Rāma resembling Vaiśravaņa, will adorned and seated on a rolled sofa, with a beautiful coverlet on.

sa: यस्य तत् पुष्पकं नाम विमानं कामगं शुभम्। वीर्यादावर्जितं भद्रे येन यामि विहायसम्॥
en: O you auspicious one, by virtue of my prowess I have taken away that beautiful chariot of his called Puspaka. Ascending that chariot you shall travei by the ethereal route.

sa: आर्तस्तस्य बिलद्वारि स्थितः संवत्सरं नृप। दृष्ट्वा च शोणितं द्वारि बिलाच्चापि समुत्थितम्॥ शोकसंविग्नहृदयो भृशं व्याकुलितेन्द्रियः।
en: O king, suffering greatly, I remained for a whole year at the mouth of the cave. And seeing blood issuing from the cave, I had my heart agitated with grief and my senses extremely overwhelmed.

sa: निष्कम्पपत्रास्तरवो नद्यश्च स्तिमितोदकाः। भवन्ति यत्र तत्राहं तिष्ठामि च चरामि च॥
en: What shall I say more? Wherever I live, even the leaves of the trees do not flutter and the currents of the rivers are stopped.

sa: कपिलेनाप्रमेयेण दग्धा हीमे महाबलाः। सलिलं नार्हसि प्राज्ञ दातुमेषां हि लौकिकम्॥
en: These highly powerful ones had been consumed by the peerless Kapila, therefore, you ought not to offer water to them in consonance with social usage.

sa: कदर्यकलुषा बुद्धिर्जायते शस्त्रसेवनात्। पुनर्गत्वा त्वयोध्यायां क्षत्रधर्मं चरिष्यसि ॥
en: From following arms, one's sense gets befouled and deformed. Again going to Ayodhyā, You will observe the duties of Kastriyas.

sa: श्रुत्वा दशरथस्यैतद् भरतः कैकयीसुतः॥ गमनायाभिचक्राम शत्रुघ्नसहितस्तदा।
en: Hearing these words of Daśaratha, Kaikeyi's son, Bharata; prepared for the journey, together with Satrughna.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा विषसादैव द्वितीयाप्रियशंसनात्। विषण्णवदनो भूत्वा भूयः पप्रच्छ मातरम्॥
en: Hearing this, Bharata apprehending a second misfortune was deeply moved; and with a sad countenance, he again asked his mother.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तु सुग्रीवं सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः। तस्थौ भ्रातृसमीपस्थो लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा॥
en: Having thus addressed Sugriva, Laksmana, the enhancer of Sumitrā's joy and the destroyer of foes, stood before his elder brother.

sa: एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं वैरानुकथनं महत्। अनागसा मया प्राप्तं व्यसनं पश्य राघव॥
en: Thus have I mentioned to you the great cause of this hostility, O Rāghava, innocent as I am, I have come by this mighty misfortune.

sa: अहमेवाहरिष्यामि स्वयं लोकान् महामुने। आवासं त्वहमिच्छामि प्रदिष्टमिह कानने॥
en: O mighty ascetic, I myself will win those regions. I wish to be directed to a dwelling in this forest.

sa: प्रतीक्षमाणस्त्वामेव नारोहेऽहं महायशः। देवलोकमितो वीर देहं त्यक्त्वा महीतले॥
en: O illustrious one, O hero, expecting you, I have not yet ascended heaven, renouncing on earth this body of mine.

sa: न कालस्यास्ति बन्धुत्वं न हेतुर्न पराक्रमः। न मित्रज्ञातिसम्बन्धः कारणं नात्मनोऽवशः॥
en: It has no friend, no cause and no one can overcome it. It has no kinsman, no relation; even it is not subject to itself.
